1. Onore no Koudou wo Furikaetta Akuyaku Reijou, Mousei shitanode Yarinaoshimasu (己の行動を振り返った悪役令嬢、猛省したのでやり直します) [Sakimori Inori x Minato]
2. Tensei Akuyaku Reijou no Inu (転生悪役令嬢の犬) [Anbata x Hirawo}
3. Danzai Zenya "Kouryaku Taishou-sha ni Watashi no Oshi ga Inainode" Senryaku teki Tettai wo shita Akuyaku Reijou wa Nazo no Aitemu Uri ni Mou Ichido Koi wo suru (断罪前夜「攻略対象者に私の推しがいないので」戦略的撤退をした悪役令嬢は謎のアイテム売りにもう一度恋をする) [sacco x Sora Hisame]
4. Koushaku Reijou wa Hametsu no Yogen wo Fumitsukeru. Tsuide ni Fiancé mo Fumitsukeru. (公爵令嬢は破滅の予言を踏みつける。ついでに婚約者も踏みつける。) [Shake Free x Mikoto Shimogiku]

title.native: 悪役令嬢にハッピーエンドの祝福を! アンソロジーコミック
title.romaji: Akuyaku Reijou ni Happy End no Shukufuku! Anthology Comic

208493.description:
Watanabe Harunobu strives to become a full-fledged samurai, despite harboring a certain secret. One day, feeling unwell, Harunobu meets the mysterious onmyoji Abe no Seimei, who is able to pinpoint the cause of his condition. Furthermore, in front of Harunobu's eyes, Seimei extends the lifespan of an aristocrat who had stopped breathing after falling into a pond. When Harunobu asks Seimei about his mysterious power, Seimei reveals that it is "medical arts." Seimei then uncovers Harunobu's secret and pressures him to become his assistant...

This is a Heian medical fantasy in which an onmyoji and his troubled assistant exorcise illnesses.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: 晴明様のおっしゃることには 平安陰陽診療録
title.romaji: Seimei-sama no Ossharu Koto ni wa Heian Onmyou Shinryoroku

208494.description:
Tae-Mi, the spoiled daughter of a chaebol family, not only repeatedly botched new ventures but also caused a major scandal with her clueless social media posts. Ultimately, at her furious father's command, Tae-Mi is demoted to Sunchang-ri, the chili pepper capital. A city girl through and through, Tae-mi screams at the sight of the remote village before her. But meeting Kang-Hun, a young farmer and breathtakingly handsome man living in a watermill at the edge of a chili field, instantly recharges her motivation. Soon, after accidentally witnessing Kang-Hun's well-built lower body and striking beauty, she throws caution to the wind and begins aggressively pursuing him... .!

A spicy-sweet, farm-fresh romance straight from the countryside!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: See You in the Chili Pepper Field!
พบรักที่ไร่พริก

208495.description:
In a fit of rage, Ga-Young quit her job and resolved to write the adult romance fantasy novel she'd always wanted to pen. Meanwhile, Do-Gyum, a middle-ranking boss in an organization suffering from insomnia, happened to meet her at the PC cafe where she worked part-time. After an incident led them to spend the night together, they formed a relationship to get what each needed...

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: The Worse It Is, the Better It Tastes

208496.description:
Seo-Jin, colorless and odorless, unaware of favorite music or colors, encounters Ju-Hwan, radiant with five-colored hues. The moment Seo-Jin sees Ju-Hwan, he falls in love, yet Ju-Hwan's heart remains unknowable. Just when he thinks they're growing closer, he pulls away; when he can barely see him, he returns to his side. Seo-Jin can't make sense of it.

Obsessed with Ju-Hwan, he stops attending school and squanders his tuition money, only to be caught by his parents. As punishment, Seo-Jin is sent into a kind of exile during the vacation. Waiting at his destination is the enigmatic owner of the mansion, Sa-Yun. Seo-Jin enters Sa-Yun's daily life, accustomed to solitude. Just as their life together begins to feel natural, Ju-Hwan arrives at the mansion. Watching them closely, Ju-Hwan senses a subtle shift in the atmosphere...

A mansion where past and present intersect, and the precarious drama of three men!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

208497.description:
Yong Seong-Il, on the verge of entering music college, lives a dissolute life with many women at his hideout until he suffers an accident where his finger is severed by a stray dog attack. After the accident, he approaches through the gap left by his missing finger, a blend of tragedy and comedy.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

208498.description:
Reborn in a dark BL novel, Rosie is a maid tasked with feeding a captive named Richard, one of the leads who is referred to as a monster. In the original plot, whenever he tries to escape, the maid on duty is killed. To avoid this grisly fate, Rosie vows to make sure he never breaks out and is determined to do her duty without incident. Yet, despite her resolve, the monster seems strangely drawn to her, binding her within his intense obsession. Is preventing his escape the least of her worries?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: The Possessive Madman Is Trying to Imprison Me
The Obsessive Maniac Is Trying To Confine Me
Asobinin na Shoujo-tachi wa Kyou mo Houkago Yatteiru

title.native: 遊び人な少女たちは今日も放課後ヤっている
title.romaji: Asobinin na Shoujotachi wa Kyou mo Houkago Yatteiru

title.native: 王家から追放された俺、魔物はびこる森で超速レベルアップします　～最弱スキルと馬鹿にされた『鑑定』の正体は、全てを見通す『神の目』でした～
title.romaji: Ouke kara Tsuihou sareta Ore, Mahou Habikoru Mori de Chousoku Level Up shimasu: Saijaku Skill to Baka ni Sareta "Kantei" no Shoutai wa, Subete wo Mitoosu "Kami no Me" deshita

208501.description:
Lee Eunjo had it all—money, a husband, a beautiful home... But it all came crashing down as she plummeted to her death. She lost everything after her husband cheated on her, stole from her, and dropped her from the terrace of their high-rise apartment. Luckily, thanks to the help of an AI system called NAVI, her soul went into the body of Na Eunjo, a young model with a stagnating career. Now, Eunjo is back and ready for revenge, stopping at nothing to reclaim everything that was taken from her.

(Source: Tapas)

208502.description:
Many years have passed since "dungeons" began to exist in the world. "Grandpa, stream a dungeon run for us! You used to be an explorer, right?" Urged by his grandchild, former dungeon explorer Genji Kudou decides to dive into a dungeon for the first time in 30 years. But Genji's dungeon strategies, shaped by the old ways rather than modern conventions, start to pile up unexpected results—until his adventures go viral and cause a sensation across the nation...!?

(Source: Magcomi, translated)
synonyms: A Former Explorer and Grandpa: I Started Streaming at the Request of my Granddaughter, but Why Did I End Up Chasing the Buzz?!

title.native: 元探索者のおじいちゃん～孫にせがまれてダンジョン配信を始めたんじゃが、なぜかバズりおったわい～
title.romaji: Moto Tansakusha no Ojiichan: Mago ni Segamarete Dungeon Haishin wo Hajimeta njaga, Nazeka Bazuriotta wai

208503.description:
Su-Won is an S-class Guide with a notorious temper and a strict "no-touching" rule. After beating up one too many Espers who tried to get handsy, he’s given one last chance to save his career: a month-long live-in contract with the powerful Esper Gong Ian. There’s just one problem. Ian is the same pervert Su-Won caught grinding against him on the bus earlier that day! To make matters worse, Ian isn't just a creep, but a massive masochist who gets off on Su-Won’s violence. Su-Won came to guide him, but he might end up beating him into bliss instead.

(Source: Lezhin US)

208504.description:
Rebecca, a timid little hamster demon, gets promoted to a personal maid for the tyrannical Demon King, Albrandt. On her very first day, she accidentally stumbles into forbidden territory and nearly dies, only to be saved by the Dragon King, who the Demon King himself imprisoned. To survive, she is forced to follow the Dragon King's orders: enter Albrandt's dreams to uncover his deepest secrets. Now, she finds herself caught between two powerful beings, each trying to keep her by their side. Between the dominating Demon King and the formidable Dragon King, who will claim her heart?

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: 新米侍女は王様に翻弄される

208505.description:
Volume 1 (2024-07-26)
1. Imouto ni Fiancé wo Yuzuttara,Hikikomori Koushaku no Henai ga matte Imashita (妹に婚約者を譲ったら、引きこもり公爵の偏愛が待っていました) [Shiwori Hiromoto]
2. Fukitsu Reijou datta no ni, Kodoku na Ouji ni Dekiai sarete Imasu (不吉令嬢だったのに、孤独な王子に溺愛されています) [Rito Yanagi]
3. Kimi ni sasagu wa Hana to Ai: Aru Botsuraku Reijou to Jiki Koushaku no Monogatari (君に捧ぐは花と愛～ある没落令嬢と次期公爵の物語～) [Rirako Kabashima]
4. Binbou Reijou wa Yandere Koushaku-sama no Chouai ni Kizukanai (貧乏令嬢はヤンデレ公爵様の寵愛に気付かない) [Inaru]

Volume 2 (2024-10-25)
1. Mura de Kiraware Mono no Watashi ga, Ryoushu-sama no Tuma ni Shimei saremashita. (村で嫌われ者の私が、領主様の妻に指名されました。) [Kotori Asatani]
2. Hanayome Shuugyou no Tame no Katei Kyoushi ga “Kimi wa Boku no Unmei no Aiteda" to Sematte kuru (花嫁修業のための家庭教師が『君は僕の運命の相手だ』と迫ってくる) [Yoiko Orie]
3. Kimi wa Mou, Inoranakute Ii: Yandere Koutaishi wa Shin no Seijo wo Nigasanai (きみはもう、祈らなくていい～ヤンデレ皇太子は真の聖女を逃がさない～) [Chiyoharu Asagi x Elleberos]
4. Botsuraku Maid no Futokyaku wa, Ai ga Omotai Henkyou!? (没落メイドの太客は、愛が重たい辺境！？) [Ashi Chidori]

title.native: ヤンデレ貴公子の重すぎる愛で幸せになります！　アンソロジー
title.romaji: Yandere Kikoushi no Omosugiru Ai de Shiawase ni narimasu! Anthology

208506.description:
Cover Illustration: Mitsuya Fuji
1. Ringoku Koutei wa Heibon na "Gakubuchi" Reijou wo Koinegau (隣国皇帝は平凡な『額縁』令嬢を乞い願う) [Inaru x Makino Maebaru]
2. Kono Shoudan wa Seiritsu Shimasu ka? (この商談は成立しますか？) [Ao Toteka]
3. Binbou Reijou wa Ikinokori wo Kakete Noroware Ouji to Kekkon Shimasu! (貧乏令嬢は生き残りを賭けて呪われ王子と結婚します！) [Mito x cmp.works]
4. Yume ka Utsutsu ka, Genkai Night Party (夢かうつつか、限界ナイトパーティー) [Yoka Itoma]
5. Hachimitsu Reijou to Kishin Kakka no Koibumi Jijou (はちみつ令嬢と鬼神閣下の恋文事情) [Chitose Azuya]
6. Saenai Reijou wa Migakareru (冴えない令嬢は磨かれる) [Tsutsuji Takahashi]

title.native: 人生どん底の芋令嬢ですが、幸せな結末を目指します！アンソロジーコミック
title.romaji: Jinsei Donzoko no Imo Reijou desu ga, Shiawase na Ketsumatsu wo Mezashimasu! Anthology Comic

208509.description:
Ferdinand, High Priest at the Temple of Ehrenfest, had three trusted confidants: knight Eckhart, scholar Justus, and attendant Lasfam. They gathered whenever occasion arose, bringing diverse information to share. What follows reveals their true selves—the stories unfolding behind the scenes of the main narrative.

Reading this will make you love the world of "Honzuki" even more! This is the start of a series of exquisite bibliophile fantasy stories told from the perspectives of the three who swore loyalty to Ferdinand!!

(Source: Corona EX, translated)

title.native: 本好きの下剋上　フェルディナンドの館にて
title.romaji: Honzuki no Gekokujou: Ferdinand no Yakata ni Te

title.native: 17歳と、18以上 ～後輩ギャルは私と××を知りたいらしい～
title.romaji: 17-sai to, 18-ijou: Kouhai Gyaru wa Watashi to xx wo Shiritairashii

208511.description:
Theo is thrilled when he finally lands a job—until he realizes what they actually hired him for.

(Source: Toomics)

title.english: I Didn't Sign Up For This

208512.description:
The beautiful Shizuku Makita turns heads wherever she goes. However, she harbors a secret she must absolutely keep hidden. Every night, she sleeps next to the rising star and heartthrob, Yuto Itsumi! Shizuku has spent countless nights wrapped in his arms, yet remains uncertain about their relationship. For the sake of Yuto's future, she tries to put an end to these sleepovers, but he refuses! "It has to be you, or...?" A pure yet scandalous love story begins!

(Source: MangaPlaza)
synonyms: You who want to be spoiled sleep next to me today

title.english: You're Sleeping Next to Me Today, Too
title.native: 甘えたい君は、今日も私の隣で眠る
title.romaji: Amaetai Kimi wa, Kyou mo Watashi no Tonari de Nemuru

title.native: 密かに推してた天使さまに逆プロデュースされることになっちゃいました!?
title.romaji: Hisoka ni Oshiteta Tenshi-sama ni Gyaku Produce Sareru Koto ni Nachaimashita!?

208514.description:
"There's no other woman I want to be with but you, Kanade." Kanade entered a contract marriage with Kazuomi, the cold and calculating CEO of a real estate development company. After a year of wasted efforts and endless disappointments, she decided to file for divorce and move out without a word. Determined to start her life anew, she soon finds herself drawn back to working for her ex-husband due to a string of unexpected events. Can she uncover what lies hidden deep within Kazuomi's heart of ice?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: The Coldhearted CEO's Passionate Proposal: Wasn't the Marriage Contract Supposed to Be Over?!
title.native: 冷徹社長の執愛プロポーズ～花嫁契約は終わったはずですが！？～
title.romaji: Reitetsu Shachou no Toai Propose: Hanayome Keiyaku wa Owatta Hazu desu ga!?

208515.description:
Motomachi Sakuya is a kind-hearted office lady. After collapsing at work, she wakes up to find that she has somehow been reincarnated in another world as a little girl!? What's more, she seems to have become a "once in a million years" existence due to her numerous rare skills... Confused, Sakuya is confronted by the appearance of a cub of the sacred beast White Tiger, the sacred beast Fenrir, and even two princes! Sakuya tries to hide her powers in order to live a peaceful life, but she can't hide her cheating side...!? A lively life in another world, loved by both fluffy creatures and people, begins!!

(Source: AlphaPolis, translated)

title.native: 転生幼女はお願いしたい: ~100万年に1人と言われた力で自由気ままな異世界ライフ~
title.romaji: Tensei Youjo wa Onegai Shitai: 100 Man-nen ni 1-ri to Iwareta Chikara de Jiyuu Kimama na Isekai Life

208516.description:
On the outskirts of the imperial palace of the great power, the Tserbakia Empire, lies a "ghost mansion" - the Palace of Verdure. In this dilapidated and rundown mansion lives Euselica, the fifth princess, abandoned by her father, the emperor. With no backing after her mother's death, she lives frugally and works hard to manage the estate her mother left her. One day, the emperor suddenly announces that a competition will be held to select the crown prince. Euselica is surprised, but thinking that if she becomes emperor, she can get revenge on her father who had neglected them, she decides to run for the competition! The condition is to "build up wealth and enrich the country within three years." The days of building wealth through military force are over. With this in mind, Euselica sets her sights on human resource development and decides to put a "certain plan" into action... The story of an abandoned princess's dramatic rise to power begins here!

(Source: AlphaPolis, translated)

title.native: 第五皇女の成り上がり！　捨てられ皇女、皇帝になります
title.romaji: Dai go Koujo no Nariagari! Suterare Koujo, Koutei ni Narimasu

synonyms: Could you love me without SEX?

title.native: セックスなしでも好いとーと？
その婚姻、受理できません！

208521.hashtag: #八女くんはちょっと攻めすぎてる
synonyms: Yamekun Is A Little Too Aggressive.

title.native: 八女くんはちょっと攻めすぎてる

208522.description:
After his single mother passes away, Ryouta finds himself buried in debt at the hands of his malicious aunt. Then, a loan shark takes pity on him and introduces him to an underground, ultra-VIP pleasure business! Once there, he meets the refined and tantalizing Keiichirou and the rough-and-tough owner of the business, Kouichirou. Before he gets his first customer, Ryouta gets pleasured, faces incredible endowment, and even experiences being a pet. But, it turns out that his body has a secret of its own!

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes the one-shot "Koko wa Boku no Shiteiseki. (ここは僕の指定席。)" and one extra chapter.

title.english: Shinjuku Bachelors and the Midnight Kitten
title.native: 新宿バチェラーと夜鳴きネコ

208523.description:
Despite being an Alpha and an Omega, Doha and Jio have survived years of friendship as bickering, hot-headed childhood friends. But all it takes is one night to ruin the status quo. When Doha goes into a sudden, unexpected rut, Jio unfortunately drops by his house at the worst possible time. While Doha needs to process the fact that he's somehow shared a night with his best friend and long-time crush, he starts seeing signs...such as Jio throwing up out of the blue, and visiting an OB/GYN on his own. Why is Jio keeping him in the dark about what's happening?! If he's pregnant, Doha is ready to step up. So, for the love of god...baby, we need to talk!

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

208524.description:
A young man living peacefully in a seaside town meets a prince who has come looking for his absolute truth—?!

(Source: Libre, translated)

title.romaji: Ao no Hitomi no Ryuu no Hime

208525.description:
"The three of us should get married!"

When I opened my eyes, I was in a world where polygamy was legal... Ema is having fun in college with her two childhood friends, Jin and Sota. While they're both important friends to her, she's actually in love with both of them! "I can't stay friends with both of them forever," she mutters to herself mere moments before suddenly getting hit by a car! When she wakes up, she's shocked to find that three years have passed. Just as she starts to notice a lot of throuples out and about, Jin and Sota propose to her at the same time!

(Source: WWWave)

title.english: A Happy Bride and Her... Two Grooms? - My Childhood Friends Want to Marry Me in a Polygamous World!
title.native: トリプルハッピーウェディング～結婚を3人で行う世界で、幼馴染の彼らと…
title.romaji: Triple Happy Wedding: Kekkon wo 3-nin de Okonau Sekai de, Osananajimi no Karere to...

208526.description:
Iron Bar High School enforces strict hair regulations—so strict they're ironclad. The moment anyone breaks the rules, the teachers' clippers start dancing. Amidst this oppression, a long-haired troublemaker ‘transfer student’ and Kwon Gi-Su, immune to the clippers, fight to change the rules and reclaim their freedom.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.native: あおい蠢動 園山二美作品集

208529.description:
“I want to come home to this house.”

I lose myself in daydreams. I read books. I eat. I sleep.
I just sort of exist there.
It all falls into place.
This is a very comfortable, special place.

In addition to seven doujin works, it's packed with newly drawn comics and essays! The first collection of everything by Chiaki Iida, the person who loves houses.

(Source: Jitsugyou no Nihonsha, translated)

title.native: おさまる家　井田千秋 作品集

208531.description:
The two brothers, born of the legitimate royal bloodline, resolve to overthrow the false king and ascend the throne. Hiding in the reed beds, they plan to cross into the neighboring country to meet their allies, but a merchant warns them of a blue-eyed strategist.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

208532.description:
Reborn into a second life, Edeline envisioned a lifetime of happiness with her fiancé, Shane—until she realized her entire world was a novel, and she was the villainess fated to die. Desperate to live, she faked her death and disappeared. But when she returns years later, the story has become something far darker. Her sweet fiancé is now an obsessive captor determined to never let her go again. Did she escape her scripted death only to find herself trapped in a gilded cage of her own making?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Thought It Was 'The End', Only to Return to a Changed Genre
I Returned Thinking It Was the Ending, But The e Genre Had Changed
I Returned Thinking It Was the Ending, But the Genre Changed

title.english: A Wholesome Love Story Turns Dark
title.native: 엔딩인 줄 알고 돌아왔더니 장르가 바뀜
title.romaji: Ending Jul Algo Dorawatdeoni Jangneuga Bakkwim

208533.description:
“An instinctive outburst is hard to handle.”

Yeon-Seo, who dreams of becoming a successful internet broadcaster, ventures into the mountains to film a vlog against a winter backdrop. In a remote mountain house, she meets Kim-Ya, a woman with a unique appearance, and feels sympathy for her difficult circumstances. Kim-Ya, trembling with loneliness, and Yeon-Seo, recognizing her unique marketability. The two join forces to start an internet broadcast, but as filming continues, Kim-Ya's inexplicable, strange behavior begins to surface. Yeon-Seo grows curious about Kim-Ya's past and starts uncovering the secrets she holds, one by one.

In the piercingly cold winter, a terror unlike anything she's ever experienced pierces Yeon-Seo.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

208534.description:
Tired of high society life in the capital, Ellia Green leaves for the port city of Charlestone at the request of her childhood friend, Tobias. There, she must find Tobias' reclusive older brother Dan, the Duke of Winselton, but he is nowhere to be seen. Instead, she finds a curious young boy, Eddy, an elaborate disguise the duke uses with his magic powers. Ellia soon ends up doting on cute little Eddy, but as the duke's feelings for Ellia grow, he wonders if he can ever reveal his true identity.

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: ทุกสิ่งของท่านดยุก

208535.description:
The Northern Demon Sect Rebellion ended in less than half a year. Though the war concluded with victory for the Central Plains martial world, the Baekri Clan was utterly annihilated by the Demon Sect in the process. Having lost all his parents and siblings, Baek-Ri Kang, the sole survivor, has but one goal: The complete annihilation of the Demon Path!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

208537.description:
Though she's illustrated many webnovels, Yejin never thought she'd wake up in one as Princess Elina following a random bike crash. Just when she's looking for a way back to her original world, the demon lord's butler shows up and offers her a tour of his castle. And so, Elina jumps at the opportunity to travel to the demon realm and learn magic that can transport her back to her own dimension. Little does she know that the demon lord's servants are scheming to make her his bride so he can produce an heir and strengthen his political power...

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: こっちを向いて、魔王様！

208538.description:
"I am no longer fit to marry the Crown Prince!"

After being poisoned repeatedly by her stepmother, the eccentric noblewoman Belladonna developed a resistance to poisons - so much so that she eventually grew to enjoy eating toxic plants. Through relentless effort, she achieved her dream of becoming a botanist. Just as her career begins to flourish, an unexpected marriage proposal arrives - from none other than the Crown Prince himself!

But life as a crown princess would mean abandoning the research she loves. Desperate to escape the engagement, Belladonna hatches a plan: she asks her close friend from the tavern, Will, to help her lose her virginity, hoping to render herself unfit for marriage.

On the day of the prince's visit, she prepares to announce that she's no longer a maiden and expects the engagement to be called off. However, the man who appears before her is...!?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.native: 毒女、誤って王太子をオトす

208539.description:
Arrogant young noble Lofus is furious. You would be, too, if you discovered your role in this world of a popular RPG is that of a petty villain who’s destined to be killed off with zero fanfare. It is an ignoble end far below someone of his stature. Though only twelve years old, Lofus is prepared to use every means at his disposal to avoid what fate has in store for him—from rooting out the corruption that incites his end to alleviating the taxes on his people. As he battles the monsters wreaking havoc over his territory, his true power—one absent in the original game—begins to awaken. For whatever reason, the commoners sing his praises, but he insists he’s only in it for himself. The curtain opens on this thrilling epic, following a young man wholly dedicated to tearing down every flag that signals his end!

(Source: Manga UP!)

208550.description:
"Please make me your disciple!!!"

Souta, who was about to graduate from high school, felt frustrated that he hadn't become the kind of ideal delinquent he had always imagined. On his way home one day, a lame-looking office worker with a neatly parted hairstyle and glasses who had gotten into trouble with Souta's delinquent friends ended up completely defeating them! To his shock, that office worker turned out to be Morohoshi Keigo, the legendary delinquent Souta had always admired! From that day on, Souta starts visiting Morohoshi whenever he has free time, determined to become his apprentice. Why did he quit being a delinquent? Why is he pretending to be such a lame office worker? As Souta finds himself constantly thinking about Morohoshi, his feelings begin to change in an unexpected way...?!

(Source: Cosmic Shuppan, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

208555.description: Struggling to adjust to university life, Yuu takes refuge in a temple in Okayama. After meeting Chiaki, the head priest’s unconventional son, his life takes a dramatic turn. A powerful, emotionally stirring human drama begins!

208556.description:
Greta, a commoner, has spent her life believing that love means little without money or status. Shaped by her parents’ failed marriage and her father’s obsession with nobility, she sees marriage as the surest way to rise above her station. Edmund, a noble, believes the opposite. Having grown up watching his parents preserve their love despite hardship, he despises Greta’s view of love and ambition. When two people with completely opposing beliefs become entangled in the world of theater, will their convictions remain unchanged—or will it make them to question what they truly believe?

(Source: WEBTOON)

208557.description: Note: Published in BE-BOY GOLD 2025 August issue for their 30th anniversary special.

title.native: ないしょのストーカーさん その後
そんな村なら抱いてしまえ

208559.description:
It all started as an accidental call.
But it was actually a phone call from three years in the future!

Masaki had finally gotten her life back together after a devastating breakup with her boyfriend, who severely mistreated her. Then, one night, she received an accidental call on her supposedly broken phone. Why does it only work with him?! Although it started as a mistake, they began calling each other more and more. What started as something light and casual has grown into a bond of healing for Masaki. Now she wants to meet Kanzaki, but there's one big problem...

What in the world is going on? Could this be destiny? A stunning story of love filled with twists and turns, born from a paradox in time!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.native: 私はソレを運命と呼びたい
title.romaji: Watashi wa Sore wo Unmei to Yobitai

208560.description:
Aoi Yagi is secretly engaged to the company's rising star, Sota. They've already met each other's parents, and she now eagerly anticipates their wedding. But out of nowhere, he tells her he wants to break off their engagement.

Hurt and betrayed, Aoi finds herself in the midst of her misery, only for the young, visionary president of their company, Haruto Kujo, to appear. Known as the "tyrant," he appoints her as the project manager of a new business venture aimed at revolutionizing the education sector and commands her to be his right-hand woman?!

"You're the one behind Sota's success, aren't you?"

How did he uncover her secret? Why does he have his eye on her? And why is he so enamored with Aoi?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: The Reason President Kujo Dotes on Me
title.native: 九条社長が私を溺愛する理由
title.romaji: Kujou Shachou ga Watashi wo Dekiaisuru Riyuu

title.native: 午前1時のフェイクラバー

208562.description:
Laetitia is a villainess and has just had her engagement to Prince Thomas called off. That's when the first prince, Jules, laid eyes on her. The more they involve themselves with the other, the more the mark on her chest begins to shine... is this the birth of a new saintess...?! The prince of this kingdom is always destined to find the saintess and satisfy her needs.

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: Who Ever Heard of a Steamy Love Story Starring a Villainess?!
title.native: 悪役令嬢なのに溺愛えっちルートなんて聞いてないっ
title.romaji: Akuyaku Reijou nanoni Dekiai Ecchi Route Nante Kiitenai

208564.description:
"Who... are you?"" Risa's beloved fiancé, Aya, got into an accident and lost his memories of her. She thought she would have to go on by herself, but Aya's actually been the one comforting her... Risa's already had enough on her plate, but now her coworkers and Aya's ex are up to something as well! But even with all that, Aya still treasures their time together from the bit of fragmented memories he has. Now Risa is ready to return the love and make memories with Aya again, regardless of who tries to stand in their way."

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: My Fiancé Lost His Memory: He Should Have Forgotten About Me, But He Still Showers Me With Love
title.native: 婚約者が記憶喪失になりまして～私のことを忘れたはずの彼がなぜか溺愛してきます～
title.romaji: Konyakusha ga Kioku Soushitsu ni Narimashite: Watashi no Koto wo Wasureta Hazu no Kare ga Naze ka Dekiai shite Kimasu

208566.description:
College student Himesaki Nozomi was a girl who took her beauty into her own hands through plastic surgery. One day she was asked by the natural beauty Tennōji Ruka to teach her how to be "cute." At first, Nozomi was irked by her ignorance. How could she ask her for something like that when she had never even tasted the pain of being ugly? However, she soon learns that Ruka has her own struggles: she’s trapped by a "princely" image that prevents her from being the girl she truly wants to be. Together, they navigate the pressures of modern lookism to forge their own paths.

(Source: Manga UP!)

Note: Originally self-published on Twitter, was then licensed by Square Enix for serialization.

title.native: 「かわいい」は、ときどき苦しい。

208568.description:
After the death of his parents, Kazuma moves to Tokyo on his own. Carrying his loneliness with him, he begins high school, where he meets Yuto, a warm and cheerful classmate who reaches out to him...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: うっとうしいくらい愛されて

208570.description:
Kwon Taejung, the youngest son of Taesung Group and a dominant alpha known for causing trouble, is sent to the redevelopment zone “Daram-dong” after sparking controversy with a road rage incident. His assignment is to complete the demolition quietly within three months and clear out the remaining residents.

The biggest obstacle in front of him is Yeon Leekyeom, the last resident of Daram-dong and an omega. Burdened by relocation fraud, his grandfather’s hospital bills, and private loan debt, Leekyeom lives a precarious life under constant threat from thugs. When the documentary team behind Nightmare of the Demolition Village attempts to cover Leekyeom’s story again, Taejung approaches him under false pretenses to prevent any report that could interfere with the project.

Leekyeom mistakes him for the new manager of a security team, and Taejung allows the misunderstanding to continue while offering calculated kindness for his own purposes. However, drawn in by Leekyeom’s faint scent, Taejung begins to take an interest he never planned on having.

Though he approached him with hidden motives, even those motives begin to fade. Yeon Leekyeom, who is sick and tired of Taejung, the “thug”, yet cannot help but crumble in front of the gentleness he shows, finds himself drawn closer day by day…

208571.description:
Philia is the daughter of an Earl and wishes to spend her life enjoying her hobbies and doing the things she likes. She has no interest in socializing with other socialites of her age and in dating the opposite sex. She enjoys reading books and listening to the stories of the coming and going merchants. She relied on her parents when it came to marriage. That is when Philia receives a marriage proposal from Duke Claude Morris, who is admired by everyone. Being unable to decline, Philia marries Claude. ? On the first night of being married, they return to the Duke's estate where he suddenly pushes her away saying "don't come near me." With a stern face, Claude says "I don't plan on having a man and woman relationship with you," and Philia begins to ask the reason but...

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Raised by a sexworker and brought up in the Love Blossom Teahouse brothel, Min-Yeong's only ever known that life. Desperate to escape nights of anonymous sex, he implores Hyuk-Soo Lee, a gangster with considerable influence, to purchase his services for the night. Little does he know he may have just leapt from the kettle and straight into the fire.

(Source: Tapas)

208581.description:
Hortensia, the daughter of a frontier lord, suddenly receives a marriage proposal. Her troubled marriage partner is Turaibis, the second prince, whose life is in danger from the queen. It was supposed to be a contract marriage to protect Turaibis, but Hortensia gradually becomes attracted to him, as he shows his kindness and interest in the flora and fauna of the frontier. However, Hortensia harbors a secret...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 辺境領主令嬢の白い結婚
title.romaji: Henkyou Ryoushu Reijou no Shiroi Kekkon

208582.description:
One day, Nina, a young girl living in the forest with her foster father, "Master," is suddenly attacked and kidnapped by an emissary from the neighboring country of Uruzgand. Confused, Nina opens the letter her Master entrusted to her. In it, she finds that Nina is "the princess of the Holy Kingdom of Arcandia," and that the flesh and blood of a saint born into royal family grants great power to beastmen. So, for the sake of her country, Nina was offered as tribute to the ruthless White Wolf King, Volga. After that, Nina attempts to escape Volga many times, but she soon learns his true purpose for kidnapping her...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 貢がれ姫と冷厳の白狼王 獣人の万能薬になるのは嫌なので全力で逃亡します
title.romaji: Mitsugare Hime to Reigen no Byakurou Ou: Juujin no Mannouyaku ni Naru no wa Iya na node Zenryoku de Toubou Shimasu

208583.description:
Mystia, a young lady aspiring to become a spirit user, puts in a lot of effort and succeeds in summoning three spirits and forming master-servant contracts with them. However, her stepsister's machinations lead to the spirits terminating the contracts. With her stepsister taking away the three spirits, Mystia sinks into despair. Then, suddenly, a fourth spirit appears before her, one she herself had summoned without even realizing it...!? "My name is Skia. Those traitorous spirits don't understand the talents you possess."

A master-servant contract fantasy featuring a hardworking, unlucky young lady and a possessive great spirit!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 精霊に「お前は主人にふさわしくない、契約破棄してくれ！」と言われたので、欲しがっている妹に譲ります
title.romaji: Seirei ni "Omae wa Shujin ni Fusawashikunai, Keiyaku Haki shite kure!' to Iwareta node, Hoshigatteiru Imouto ni Yuzurimasu

208584.description:
Angelica, a former yankee delinquent who’s been reincarnated as a noble young lady in another world, survives her sister’s etiquette training and somehow reaches her debutante—but at the party she feels a man’s eyes on her and instinctively glares back. Unfortunately, the man is a coldhearted duke! Just when she thinks she’s picked a fight with someone way out of her league, the duke, for some reason, finds his heart fluttering at Angelica’s fiery stare?!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: ガン飛ばされたので睨み返したら、相手は公爵様でした。これはまずい。

208586.description:
A Supernatural Mismatch Made in Heaven

Paranormal incidents heat up when two mysterious men cross paths in Tomoe, a small town in Hiroshima with a long history of supernatural encounters.

Misato Miyazawa is a strikingly beautiful young man with a troubled past. Born to a distinguished family of onmyoji—specialists in divination—Misato is no stranger to the occult. That’s why he jumps at the chance to join the Abnormal Disaster Unit in Tomoe’s Town Hall Crisis Management Division, a unit more commonly known as The Spirit Hunters.

Enter Ryouji Karino, a fiery, handsome man with peculiar green and silver eyes. Working as a freelance monk and raised by a man claiming to be a tengu, Ryouji is by no means an average citizen. When he finds Misato in a sticky situation, he ‘kindly’ steps in, and the mismatched pair end up living together.

What dark mysteries will unravel before them as they attempt to confront paranormal happenings under the constraints of government rules?

(Source: Cross Infinite World)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

208590.description:
The Ryu brothers, Ryu Hyeon and Ryu On, raised in the same room, the same house, the same time. Ryu Hyeon, praised by the world as the noble and perfect eldest son, is in fact neither man nor woman, bearing a ‘defect’ in his body. To carry on the line, he receives seed from unknown men. One day, Lord Yun, their father, reveals his secret plan to Hyeon: to conceive a child with his own brother, Ryu On.

"How could you bear the seed of a mongrel? Receive superior seed to produce something superior."

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

208591.description:
1. Menkyokaiden! (免許皆伝！); Reijin uno! Vol. 27
2. Utsukushiki dake ka na (美しきだけかな); Reijin uno! Vol. 28
3. Danshi no Tachiiri wo Kinzu! (Kamisama wa Ka) (男子の立ち入りを禁ず！（神様は可）); Reijin uno! Vol. 32
4. Nengoro ya Goro (ねんごろやごろ); Reijin uno! Vol. 30

7. Daisankai Seme Kaigi (第三回攻会議); kakioroshi

208592.description:
Yi-Rim lives to beat Kang Si-Heon, the undisputed star of the race track. Known as "King Cobra" for his lethal precision on the road, Si-Heon seems completely untouchable. That is, until Yi-Rim catches a glimpse of his secret. Armed with shocking new information and a sudden, uncontrollable curiosity, Yi-Rim finds his rivalry taking a turn into uncharted territory...

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

208593.description:
An experimental potion designed to grant superhero powers backfires on genius comic geek Kim Seo-Hee, leaving his body dramatically transformed. But his secretive junior, Seo Tae-Oh, is right there to lend a hand. Driven by years of unrequited love and hidden desire, Tae-Oh offers to "test" Seohee's sensitive new body. Caught in a trap set by his handsome junior, the naive senior finds himself helpless against Tae-Oh's scheming passion.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

208594.description:
Having a huge crush on Varney the tattoo artist, Eden dresses up and walks over to his parlor to impress him. But one thing leads to another, and he's bouncing on top of Varney in a tattoo chair with a bite mark on his neck! Not long after the vampire wrecks him, Eden somehow finds himself alone in the parlor with Lobold, a werewolf in heat! As he's ravaged by one supernatural being after the other, Eden can't help but wonder if tattoos really are bad luck, like his mother said...

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

208595.description:
Ha-Jun, an underground indie band member. He believes without a doubt that he'll become a star someday, so he manages his private life more meticulously than anyone else. Yet, his ‘sexual desire’ is the one thing he can't easily control. Just as he was trying to ignore his mounting sexual urges, he witnessed something truly shocking(?) at the upstairs neighbor's place, where he'd gone to fix a leak....

“If we ever do it someday... I'll make sure to satisfy you...”

...This bastard, he took off his pants?!

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

208596.description:
Yiban is a perfectly normal student who joins his university's volunteer club only to find its members trying to cure a guy's lack of erotic stimulation through unconventional means. Horrified by their crazy antics, Yiban tries to make a run for it... but is stopped by an unexpected reaction in his pants! Although he swears that he's straight and hates this chaotic situation, he has a feeling escaping this unconventional club won't be as easy as he thought.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: The Guys Behind the Strange Rumors

208597.description:
A man seeking family background, a woman seeking financial support. It was supposed to be a loveless, arranged marriage. But Renande falls in love with his wife, Elise, who is pure and kind to everyone, and the two begin a happy married life. But the story doesn't end with a happy ending.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 愛人を囲う冷徹な伯爵との典型的な政略結婚、そして嫌われからの溺愛、その結末。
title.romaji: Aijin wo Kakou Reitetsu na Hakushaku to no Tenkeiteki na Seiryaku Kekkon, Soshite Kiraware kara no Dekiai, Sono Ketsumatsu.

208598.description:
Wakatsuki Shino, 29, is your average office worker in her 30s who's about to marry a colleague. But... the morning after drinking with her boss, she finds herself "confined" in his apartment under the pretext of "protection." The reason: the Earth is about to end... Boss, are you serious?

A slightly strange romantic comedy for adults.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 地球が終わるらしいので、いまからキミを監禁します。
title.romaji: Chikyuu ga Owarurashiinode, Ima kara Kimi wo Kankin Shimasu.

208599.description:
After being selected as an advertising model for a high-end lipstick brand, the wildly popular model Kakan receives death threats. To create more buzz, her agency takes out 300 million yen insurance on just Kakan's lips, and also decides to have a bodyguard by her side 24 hours a day. The bodyguard who arrives, Rion, is a straight-laced man who shows no interest in Kakan, and Kakan feels resentment towards him...

"If I lose control, I might damage your lips and mouth..."

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: ルージュ・シークレットサービス

208601.description:
Yebisu Graphics is a design firm filled with top-notch men in both talent and looks. For Masunaga, a designer there, Hisaie, a self-centered, womanizing genius, is a nasty presence he could call his "natural enemy." The beloved BL collaboration masterpiece YEBISU Celebrities has been beautifully adapted into a manga featuring the hugely popular Kuge x Masunaga pairing!

(Source: Libre, translated)

208605.description:
Asuka is your almost typical teenage girl. She studies hard in school, gossips with her friends, and does her chores. The one thing that makes her different from everyone else is her crush. She's in love with someone close to her. Her mother.

(Source: Sekai Project)

A Wish for the One I Love

208608.description:
"I can't let you go outside when you incite the desire to dominate..."

"The way he's caressing my entire body from head to toe... is so pleasant, so hot that I'm going to die..."

Riko, an office lady, suddenly ends up in another world one day. The one who appears before her is a picture-perfect, dreamy, masculine prince. For some reason, just being near him makes Riko's body ache and heat up, triggering a powerful heat that she has never experienced before. Although she knows it's indecent, she can't help expressing her longing for him...!! To top it all off, she learns that in order to suppress her heat, she needs to accept an alpha's semen deep inside her. What is the "King's Omega"? The answer lies within the pages of this authentic, mature parallel world story, with instinct and destiny intertwining.

(Source: Mobile Media Research)

208611.description: Shina Komatsu, a world-renowned makeup artist in her previous life, was pushed down the stairs by a jealous rival. In the aftermath, she finds herself reincarnated as Elfride, a noble lady from her favorite shoujo manga, The Sparkling Aquamarine. However, she awakens two years before the original story begins—and to her shock, Elfride is already infamous as the most despised noblewoman in high society! Now, Shina must navigate this treacherous world of nobility, where everyone already hates her character. But things take an unexpected turn when the First Prince, the most powerful and sought-after bachelor, suddenly proposes… a contract marriage?! Will Shina, as Elfride, be able to rewrite her doomed fate, win over the prince’s heart, and survive the cutthroat social games—or is she destined to remain the villainess everyone loathes?
synonyms: The Hated Noble Lady, Yet in a Contract Marriage With the First Prince?!

title.native: 嫌われ令嬢なのに、第一王子と契約結婚ですか！？
title.romaji: Kiraware Reijou nanoni, Daiichi Ouji to Keiyaku Kekkon desu ka!?

208612.description:
Why are you taking away my relaxed daily life…

The hero who saved the world from an alien invasion war, Takashi Shibuzaki. The dream of this legendary warrior is only one... “To live a normal high school life”

After the war ended, he was excited that this wish would be realized, and he immediately decided to return and live a quiet life in Japan. However, his comrade-in-arms from Northern Europe, Natalie, somehow ends up moving into Takashi’s house, claiming it as “living together”…?

Everything he would do for a peaceful youth. Takashi, the most powerful warrior who wants to avoid love and fighting, will he be able to obtain the peace he wants–?

title.native: 戦地から帰ってきたタカシ君。普通に高校生活を送りたい
title.romaji: Senchi kara Kaettekita Takashi-kun. Futsuu ni Koukou Seikatsu wo Okuritai

208614.description: Celestia, the daughter of a ducal family, was born with a single “mission” — to bear a child and continue the bloodline. However, her fifth marriage partner, Count Roosevelt, shows no interest whatsoever in sharing a bed with her, repeatedly rejecting her advances. Then she comes to realize the truth… He hates Celestia. Even separation from such a husband is not permitted, and Celestia falls into despair. But the feelings he has hidden deep within his heart are completely different from what Celestia imagined!? “Once I’ve obtained you, I won’t let you go.” Is this twisted obsession hatred… or love? This is the story of a husband and wife, each harboring different emotions, as they slowly come to truly bond with one another.
synonyms: My Fifth Arranged Marriage Is With You, Who Hates Me

208616.description:
Ribbontail is an idol-type hero whose only redeeming quality is her cuteness, and she dreams of one day being recognized for her heroic abilities. But her new buddy is Zex, the most advanced and most powerful autonomous robot in history. Despite Zex showing no signs of opening up, Ribbontail is excited that she can accomplish great things together with Zex, but she gets caught up in an unexpected incident...

(Source: Hero's, translated)

208617.description:
What happens when The Boss with a Past marries The Bachelorette after zero days of dating?! Ayaka's been enjoying her life and her job; she has no intention of getting married any time soon. She's been working at her dream company, inspired by her incredible boss Kunihiro Kasai, and living life to the fullest. That is, until her country bumpkin parents and one of the upper brass badger her about her single status, and this undue pressure convinces her to get totally drunk. The next think she knows, there's a filled-out marriage certificate in front of her and someone whispering softly in her ear. Who's her sudden groom...? None other than Kunihiro! Can a chaotic marriage of convenience turn into something more? A comic version of the hit romance on Love 365: Find Your Story!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: Oops, I Said Yes!: Kunihiro Kasai
title.native: うっかり婚～目覚めたら、ワケあり上司の妻でした 葛西 国広編～
title.romaji: Ukkari Kon - Mezametara, Wakeari Joushi no Tsuma deshita Kasai Kunihiro-hen

208618.description:
After her mother's passing, Mio is left completely and utterly alone. One day, a man shows up out of the blue, taking her in after claiming to be her father. Mio is soon used as a tool for a political marriage. She is told to marry into the Ichijo family, and to give birth to a son within a year. The Ichijos are prestigious; they have ties to the imperial family, work under the emperor, and have served as exorcists. However, the head of the Ichijos, Kazuomi, shows no interest in Mio, and even refuses to speak to her. A fate worse than death awaits Mio if she can't give birth to a son in time... Mio spends day to day in despair, but one day, she learns of a major secret about the Ichijo family. Kazuomi's tune begins to change once it becomes clear that Mio also possess a special power that connects her to this secret!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: The Stand-In Bride: My Fake Marriage to the Ichijo Family
title.native: 仮初めの花嫁　一条家に嫁いだ私の偽り婚姻譚
title.romaji: Kari Hajime no Hanayome Ichijou-ka ni Totsuida Watashi no Itsuwari Konin Tan

synonyms: Romance is the key to room 304

title.native: ロマンスは304号室のカギ

208620.description:
Tell us your ghost stories. Mizumuu Channel presents "neighborhood horror stories" (bankowadan) that author Mizumura Yuuya has actually heard and collected, in the form of manga. We're sure there'll be something that's on your wavelength, so please check it out when you have some free time.

(Source: Hero's, translated)

title.native: 水ムーちゃんねる 隣の晩怖談

208621.description:
Noelle runs a bakery and cafe, Le Blanc after she lost her father half an year ago. However the lord of manor is giving pressure to her to sell the place. All the customers are afraid of the lord and no one comes to eat at her place. Then one day, a man comes to eat at the cafe. He is dressed in an old-fashioned armor and yells "I missed you so much, Ange!" "Sir, Ange is the name of my ancestor." He was the "fallen knight" Lancelot from three hundred years ago! And he had sweet teeth.

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: Speciality for the Fallen Knight ~I Fell in Love with my Ancestor's Fiancé
title.native: 堕ちた聖騎士さまに贈るスペシャリテ 恋した人はご先祖さまの婚約者でした。
title.romaji: Ochita Seikishi-sama ni Okuru Specialty: Koishita Hito wa Gosenzo-sama no Konyakusha deshita.

title.native: きまぐれミルクティー

208623.description:
Julietta, the saint of knowledge, is forced to marry into the Iserta Empire, which is on the brink of defeat, despite knowing she is being removed as a nuisance, due to a 400-year-old promise. Her fiancé, Lukino, is also a young man of commoner origins who has been elevated to the position of emperor.

In the worst possible circumstances, the two are touched by each other's kindness, and eventually perform a "miracle" that turns the tide of the war on its head.

"I look forward to working with you, partner."

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 聖女と皇王の誓約結婚　恥ずかしいので聖女の自慢話はしないでくださいね…！
title.romaji: Seijo to Sumeragi Ou no Seiyaku Kekkon Hazukashii no de Seijo no Jiman Banashi wa Shinaide kudasai ne...!

208624.description:
Beatrice works hard as a magical alchemist in place of her late grandfather, the previous Duke, protecting the Duke of Isenburg. But one day, her selfish and horrible husband suddenly asks for a divorce and kicks her out of the house. Beatrice is at a loss when the fluffy alchemist beasts and fairies she used to spend time with at the Duke's house appear before her...!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 家を追放された魔法薬師は、薬獣や妖精に囲まれて秘密の薬草園で第二の人生を謳歌する
title.romaji: Ie wo Tsuihou sareta Mahou Kusushi wa, Yakujuuya Yosei ni Kakomarete Himitsu no Yakusou-en de Daini no Jinsei wo Ouka suru

208625.description:
Bianca, the first princess of the Kingdom of Northernbleu, is in dire straits after a neighboring country targets her lands. The only way to save her country is to establish ties with a major power... That's when a proposal arrives from Saintrews, the most powerful country on the continent! Bianca, who has known the second prince, Lucas, since she was a child, accepts marriage as a desperate act of friendship. However, he has grown up to become a Knight Commander feared as ruthless and heartless by other nations. Indeed, no longer the kind-hearted boy she once knew. Stunned by his change, Bianca is prepared for his cold-hearted encounter... But what actually awaits are days of sweet favor, drawing her closer to the boy she once knew, now all grown up...? So begins a love fantasy that starts as a political marriage and grows into the knight commander doting on Bianca!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: As The Black Knight Pleases A Political Marriage with a Passionate Lover
title.native: 黒騎士様のお気に召すまま～政略結婚のはずが溺愛されています～
title.romaji: Kuro Kishi-sama no Oki ni Mesu Mama: Seiryaku Kekkon no Hazu ga Dekiaisareteimasu

208626.description:
Asakuma is a literary editor. He's swamped with work, but by chance he ends up modeling for famous hair and makeup artist Kozuki's makeup. After completing the project "A Tired Old Man Transforms with Kozuki's Makeup," Kozuki invites him to his house and confesses his feelings, saying, "I've got my eye on you."

Will Asakuma's lifestyle and skin improve, and will his dreams come true? A story of a tired male editor's makeover!!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 十日間だけ無理してよ

208627.description:
Yokoyari Mengo depicts the intense emotions of women × women!! This is the story of that beautiful girl who I loved and wanted to protect.

(Source: Shueisha, translated)
synonyms: 横槍メンゴ新作読切シリーズ Vol.1
Yokoryari Mengo Shinsaku Yomikiri Series Vol.1

208628.description:
To avenge her murdered parents, and to bring peace to the people, a justice-driven princess of a fallen kingdom rises up alongside her retainer! But the princess herself is unbelievably weak?! A spunky princess and the ultimate retainer! A rising star delivers a 53-page, action comedy one-shot of vengeance and salvation!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

208629.description:
Angel Amelia descends to the human world to save Lucian, an archangel who once saved her but has since fallen from grace. But for some reason, he’s working as a host in Kabukicho! Can she bring him back to heaven from this city of the night, swirling with worldly desire…?

(Source: MANGA Plus)

208630.description:
Two years after moving to Tokyo, Kizamu Kamoda has lost all his money and is searching for work when he stumbles upon a sushi bar. There he meets the master, a guy in nothing but a loincloth and a face right off a fish! Kizamu starts working right away, but it seems this place also performs exorcisms at night...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

208631.description:
In a world where humanity has become food for an alien species, Kiri, a doctor, loses everything and is taken captive herself. However, after saving an alien mother and child with her medical knowledge, she discovers a possible way to kill them…?

(Source: MANGA Plus)

208632.description:
Hiyori is plunged into despair after the death of Mikhail, the angel character she simped for. However, when she discovers Yuki Kuon, a basketball prodigy who is the spitting image of Mikhail, her life changes completely. As she pursues her, she finds herself joining a prestigious basketball club before she knows it...?!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

208633.description:
Hojo, a motorcycle courier, picks up a delivery order and goes to an apartment, where he meets Aranami, a popular novelist. Hojo happens to witness Aranami's male partner, and realizes that Aranami is gay. Hojo thinks he will never see Aranami again. But a few days later, he receives another mail order. Feeling a bit embarrassed about seeing Aranami again, Hojo discovers that Aranami loves cats and when he asks Hojo to set a cat meowing as his ringtone, Hojo thinks Aranami is cute. A certain casual remark by Hojo unsettles Aranami. The words Hojo says remind Aranami of his past... When they meet by chance at a yakitori bar, in the flow of the conversation, Hojo tells him that he is also gay. Aranami suggests, "if you are willing, would you keep me company tonight?" It is simply a comprehensive decision for Aranami, but the world around them starts to change color...

(Source: Takeshobo)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

208634.description:
High school boy Asahina is the son of the school principal, and he's troubled by the fact that he's playing the role of a rich kid, despite his own wishes. One day, a transfer student named Pome arrives in Asahina's class from a foreign country with a unique culture. Asahina is astonished by Pome's unconventional behavior, and for some reason, Pome starts to get closer to him...

A laid-back, cross-cultural exchange between a naive transfer student from a foreign country and a rich kid who wants to break out of his shell: a laid-back, cross-cultural boy's life ♡

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: ポメくんは母国語で愛を囁く
title.romaji: Pome-kun wa Haha Kokugo de Ai wo Sasayaku

title.romaji: Karasuya Satoshi no Shin Bikkuri Curry

title.native: 必ずあなたの役に立つ海馬
title.romaji: Kanarazu Anata no Yaku ni Tatsu Kaiba

title.native: チャンネル・ヴァンパイア

La paix mondiale par le plaisir

208643.description:
Do-Yun, who moved to a quiet village in the countryside, accidentally found a white fox collapsed on the road and brought it home, naming it Haru. That very night after bringing the fox home, Do-Yun dreams of having relations with a mysterious white-haired man. Startled awake, Do-Yun finds a small child sleeping soundly beside him...

“Could it be... you're Haru...?”

“Huh?”

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

208644.description:
Seoul, a second-year medical student at Korea University, was relieving academic stress in a secretive way he couldn't tell anyone about—

“Huh, hmm... right here feels so good...”

...masturbating his prostate while listening to sticky slime ASMR in his single dorm room. But when the dorm undergoes remodeling, he suddenly becomes roommates with Jin-Hu, a physical education major. His alone time vanishes, and Seoul's pent-up frustration reaches its limit....

“From now on, you're my dildo.”

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

synonyms: Becoming Friends With a Yankee Girl

title.native: ギャル、明日も来るって

208648.description:
The strongest fighter at the worst high school in the country, Dupaul High School: Ryu U-Jin. He never loses a fight, but in reality, he's a romance novel maniac and an aspiring webtoon artist. Determined to find true romance, Ryu U-Jin decides to transfer to an ordinary co-ed school. Will he be able to find sweet romance material at his new school and create a proper work?

(Source: Naver, translated)

208649.description:
Legendary creators Lee Hyeon-Se and Lee Du-Hu personally produced Hell Camp Short Story Collection Season Seven!

(Source: Naver, translated)

Stories included:
1. Appareul Jom Saranghaebwa (아빠를 좀 사랑해봐) [Na-Hyeon Kwon]
2. ZAPATEADO (자파테아도) [Geom]
3. Jjajeungnajiman Meosisseo (짜증나지만 멋있어) [Jeong-Su]
4. Heeomchineun Sae (헤엄치는 새) [S.P Potato]

208651.description:
Assistant Manager Yi-Wol Kim has spent five years working a day job—and five years doing “stand-in stanning” for his boss’s daughter’s favorite idol group, Spark. During yet another Spark-related overtime, he collapses… and wakes up nine years in the past with a second chance at life. But this chance comes with a cruel condition: to undo his sister’s death, Yi-Wol must debut as a member of Spark himself. Thrown into the idol life he never wanted, he’ll have to survive fame, internal politics, and his own reluctant heart.

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

208653.description:
The corporate drone dies and is reborn as a witch, only to be immediately ensnared by the white-haired vampire Alice, who binds her in a blood pact! In her loli form, she's clingy and adorable, the only one you can rely on. In her mature form, she's fierce and protective, her combat prowess maxed out. The bond forged through shared blood is sweet enough to make you dizzy. Yet dark currents already churn beneath the city's surface. Beneath the blood pact lies an unsolvable mystery—their meeting was never mere coincidence...

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

208654.description:
A monster lives in the Rohanson manor. It wears the skin of the dead Lady Evangeline. While she believes she is the heroine of a romance story, to everyone else, she is a haunted nightmare.

(Source: Manta)

My Transmigration Became a Ghost Story

Ressuscitée le jour de mes funérailles !

title.english: My Possession Became a Ghost Story

208655.description:
The musical VTuber Kaji Lion suddenly announces their hiatus. When fans visit the places that inspired Kaji Lion's songs, a phenomenon known as "song dive" occurs. This is an episodic story about Kaji Lion's devoted young fans making pilgrimages to those sacred sites, hoping to inspire Kaji Lion to return.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: しかし火事獅子歌詞可視化

Notes:

- Includes one extra chapter.

208657.description:
Sayaka Mizukoshi is an office lady working at Five Star Pharmaceuticals, a major medical company. Since graduating college, she'd remained single to focus solely on her career, yet she never once regretted it. Because she can stay by the side of the company's handsome and capable president, Shinya Godai, serving as his personal secretary.

Working alongside the man she admired and respected beyond romantic feelings… that was her happiness. But that happiness suddenly crumbled one hungover morning… A splitting headache from drinking too much, a warm hand touching her… completely naked body!? Peering at the the man sleeping beside her, it's unmistakably the president's face!! Mizukoshi panicked, but as she felt the lingering traces of last night's events on her body, she thought.

"I'm probably going to be late for work today…"

And so begins the romantic torment of a president's secretary, all stemming from one night's mistake!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

208658.description:
Mao Sugaya is a hot up-and-coming actor whose latest TV show is all the rave. His manager negotiates with the one-of-a-kind genius artist Eishi Kaida for him to do the theme song. Mao is through the roof when he finds out since he's a huge fan of Eishi's. However, Eishi agrees to work with Mao on one condition: that they spend an entire day together, and if he gets no inspiration for the song, the negotiation is off. Eishi avoids appearing in the media and hardly shows his face publicly, so Mao has no idea what Eishi looks like exactly. Once Mao meets Eishi, feelings of fear for someone from his past come rushing back to him. Although Mao is uneasy around Eishi, he proposes they spend the day pretending to be on a date...! What will Eishi say...?

This is the beginning of Mao and Eishi's love story!

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title.english: I Think I've Loved Him Ever Since Then
title.native: あの時からスキだったんだと思う
title.romaji: Ano Toki kara Suki dattan da to Omou

208659.description:
Ten-year-old Ferris is a slave working in a mine for magic crystals. One day, mysterious magicians attacked and destroyed the mine, and Ferris is the sole survivor. While fleeing, she impulsively rescues a beautiful girl named Alicia who was about to be kidnapped by suspicious men. As thanks, Ferris is invited to Alicia's mansion, where her magical talent is discovered— A heartwarming magic academy story about a ten-year-old girl with the brightest smile and strongest magic!

(Source: Hero Comics, translated)

208660.description:
The story takes place in the Tenmei era in Edo. The place is a paradise for men, where men flock to seek out Yoshimachi Daietsu. Kaede, the eldest son of a prestigious samurai family, is sold to the Hanakagoya teahouse. When he meets Ren, a haughty, frivolous, and flamboyant male prostitute, the wheels of their destiny begin to turn... The story of a beautiful flower who sells sex and lies begins here!

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title.romaji: Kage no Hana wa Ori ni Saku

208661.description:
Ishida is a boy who lives by the motto: "Always do the right thing, without expecting anything in return." Starting high school, Ishida meets a blonde beauty, Athena Fujisaki, whose attitude is the complete opposite. She will do anything to help those in need — however, she's no pure-hearted do-gooder. She's a demanding girl who wants an equal return for every favor she does! A coming-of-age comedy about a well-meaning but chaotic girl whose goodwill goes off the rails, and the laid-back boy caught in her wake!!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

208663.description:
The witch Sue lives in hiding to escape persecution. However, when she saves a boy named Rose from drowning, he seems to have been put under a nasty spell...? Includes the title story and three other stories.

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

208664.description:
To protect the one he loves, Lin Xiuyuan played a kind trick and successfully made the boy live together with him. The life after living together is, however, completely different from what he expected! Will he change his mind, or be in love with everything about his beloved?!

(Source: Webcomics)

208666.description:
Unassuming tourist Mio Hiraishi is finally taking the trip she always wanted... only to find herself face-to-face with the Prince of the Hua Feng crime family?! Standing at the top of the infamous Yuehong Syndicate, Liu Xian is ruthless, gorgeous and powerful-- and looking for a mistress! But as a dangerous liaison turns into a passionate romance... will Mio leave her new life of luxury, or risk it all for love?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.native: 寵愛マフィア～恋したのは、危険な男
title.romaji: Chouai Mafia: Koishita no wa, Kiken na Otoko

208667.description:
26-year-old Mio Akemi is a beautiful, talented woman who always wears a poker face in the office. She's finally got a boyfriend, Atsuhiro, who she's been seeing for three months... and she still finds him absolutely adorable!!!! Everything Atsuhiro says and does makes Mio's heart flutter. So much so, she's not sure she'll be able to survive even a normal date. Though their relationship isn't progressing due to Mio's excessive adoration for him, she still experiences romantic bliss. Then one day, Atsuhiro's sick, so Mio goes over to his place to care for him. But, her usually kind and sweet boyfriend suddenly acts uncharacteristically rough and demanding...!! Could it be that Atsuhiro's actually a... werewolf? Mio is from a family that has been the sworn enemy of the werewolf clan for hundreds of years! This is the start to their wild and unpredictable relationship...!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: My Cute Boyfriend Is Just To Die For! -Head-Over-Heels For My Sworn Enemy, A Werewolf-
title.native: 今日もカレシに萌え殺される。～宿敵オオカミに溺愛されてます～

208669.description:
One day, Arthur realizes that he’s been reincarnated as the villain in a BL game. On top of that, he remembers that based on the plot of the game, he only has endings like the “Imprisonment Ending” and “Tentacle Ending” waiting for him! With no other option to save his chastity and life, his only way out is getting his fiancée to get with the protagonist! Dragging along his trusty servant Edgar, he tries to craft up schemes to get the two of them together. But, rather than being hated as the villain, he starts raising BL flags of his own?!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 愛してほしいのは俺じゃないのに！ 〜BLゲームの悪役令息に転生したのに嫌われなくて困ってます〜

208670.description:
Ren, an α office worker, is rivals with his fellow α colleague Yuuma, competing for the top spot in sales. One day, the two of them are exposed to an Ω's heat and end up going into rut. They try to calm each other down by pleasuring one another, but Ren unexpectedly finds his heart racing for Yuuma when he sees his usually combative rival coming onto him with the face of a lustful male. Since that day, Ren hasn't been feeling like himself, only for a doctor to tell him he's "on the verge of turning into an Ω"!? Becoming an Ω is no joke!!

A heart-pounding love story between rival colleagues: a charismatic α x a serious α.

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

208692.description:
It's been 30 years since dungeons appeared in Japan. Kyoichi passed the entrance exam to the same extremely competitive high school as his childhood fiancée, Tsubaki, but rumors of him kneeling before a goblin made him the target of teasing in class. He explores the dungeon in an attempt to turn the situation around, but is defeated by a group of goblins. Thinking of his younger sister, Koyoi, he prepares himself for death... when he is saved by the Dungeon Ruler, Kyoji. This encounter marks a turning point in Kyoichi's fate.

Get stronger with every battle! The story of conquering unrivaled dungeons with your sister begins!

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title.native: ダンジョンで成り上がれ! ～幼馴染からも嫌われてゴブリンにさえ勝てなかった俺が、ダンジョンルーラーの指導を受けたら強くなれたので妹と無双します～
title.romaji: Dungeon de Nariagare!: Osananajimi kara no Kirawarete Goblin ni Saekate Nakatta Ore ga, Dungeon Ruler no Shidou wo Uketara Tsuyoku Nareta no de Imouto to Musou shimasu

208694.description:
Erica has the mysterious power to hear the inner thoughts of people. While working as a maid at the castle, every night she hears the voice of someone suffering from fatigue... The owner of the voice is none other than the invincible Emperor Julius, hailed as a superhuman. When she begins to help him sleep in order to restore his peaceful daily life, she hears a lustful cry: "I love you, Erica, I want to put it inside you!" This time, she hears a lewd cry of desire. Could the usually cool-headed Julius really do something like this...?!

A slightly erotic love story between the out-of-control (or perhaps a bit out of character?) Emperor and his loyal maid!

(Source: Printemps Shuppan, translated)

title.native: 陛下、心の声がうるさすぎます。私へのえっちな妄想はお控えください!?
title.romaji: Heika, Kokoro no Koe ga Urusugimasu. Watashi e no Ecchi na Mousou wa Ohikae kudasai!?

208696.description:
“Do you like me?”

In eighth grade, Hwi-Min gets caught with a photo of his crush, Jung-Won, and ends up receiving unwanted attention. Whether it was luck or misfortune, the commotion quickly died down thanks to his already-existing status as a total outcast. Time passed indifferently, with no entanglement between the popular, cool Jung-Won and the nerdy, awkward Hwi-Min. After enough time passed for what once felt like a life-or-death situation to become a nostalgic black history, the now-adult Hwi-Min lives a peaceful, ordinary life as an unknown band member juggling multiple part-time jobs...

Until one day, he finds Jung-Won in an alley... or rather, he ends up picking him up?

“Can I stay at your place?”

“I'll pay you back with my body in exchange for a place to sleep.^^”

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

title.native: つくろう！メスガキソープ部！

208698.description:
"Will you marry me?" he asks as his fingers intimately trace inside me. This marriage will have an end, but as pleasure overwhelms me, my answer comes instinctively.

Minami Sugimoto, a cafe employee, is troubled by her low libido. Her worries spilled out one night when a handsome regular customer invites her for drinks, and in a moment of drunken candor, she reveals her secret. "Perhaps you just haven't been with the right person yet," he suggests, easing me onto the bed. He teases my nipples, his touch both tender and exhilarating. The sensation is so exquisite, I feel I could melt. He promises "If you marry me, I'll make you feel even better." And with that proposition, their contractual marriage begins, founded on a hopeful, yet painful, lie. To be cherished so deeply... it's an unexpected burden.

(Source: MangaPlaza)
synonyms: Watashi-tachi wa Rikon suru. Fukaku, Amaku, Tsunagatte...

title.english: We're Getting Divorced: A Deep & Sweet Connection...
title.native: 私たちは離婚する。深く、甘く、繋がって…
title.romaji: Watashitachi wa Rikon Suru. Fukaku, Amaku, Tsunagatte...

208699.description:
After seven years of being single for being too traditional, Nanami moves home only to find a pack of firefighters living right next door. She hopes for a fresh "fateful encounter" but is harassed by the sound of porn all night long. Though she tries to ignore her rowdy neighbors, Nanami didn't expect intimidating firefighter, Minato, to corner her with a promise: he's going to make her his girlfriend. A spicy love story about a woman rediscovering her youth with a man who won't take "no" for an answer.

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: The Intimidating Firefighter Next Door: His Smile Gets Me Even Though He's So Indecent
title.native: となりの強面消防士 ～破廉恥なくせにその笑顔は反則です～
title.romaji: Tonari no Kowamote Shouboushi: Harenchi na Kuse ni Sono Egao wa Hansoku desu

208700.description:
Constance Grail, known as Connie, is a plain and ordinary Viscount's daughter, and Scarlet Castiel, the daughter of a duke who was once executed as an unparalleled villain. Connie is saved from a difficult situation by Scarlet's ghost, but in exchange, she must continue to accompany her on her quest for revenge.

Due to certain circumstances, Connie and her friends end up visiting Elsor, the homeland of Scarlet's late mother. According to Scarlett, this is where "the Star Crown of the Faris Empire's last princess rests."

(Source: Drecom, translated)

title.native: 死体役令嬢に転生したら黒幕王子に執着されちゃいました
title.romaji: Shitaiyaku Reijou ni Tensei Shitara Kuromaku Ouji no Shuuchakusare Chaimashita

208702.description:
Princess Platina, a devoted saint to her kingdom despite enduring cruel mistreatment, receives devastating news—she doesn’t have long to live. Her stepsister seals her fate by ordering her on a harsh pilgrimage to the Holy Land, effectively banishing her from the royal castle. Eisen, a captive knight, is forced to accompany her as both attendant and witness to her death. What will become of their lives on this journey...?

(Source: Manga UP!)
synonyms: The Banished Saint's Pilgrimage: From Dying to Thriving

title.native: 余命わずかだからと追放された聖女ですが、巡礼の旅に出たら超健康になりました
title.romaji: Yomei Wazuka Dakara to Tsuihou Sareta Seijo Desu ga, Junrei no Tabi ni Detara Chou Kenkou ni Narimashita

208703.description:
Amarion grew up in a kingdom beset by monsters and took up the sword when she was just 10. Years later, the king introduces her as the kingdom's strongest knight to Victor Mort, a grand duke from a neighboring empire said to have no equal in battle. Impressed, he proposes to her immediately, which she accepts to receive aid for her people. After the marriage, though, she finds herself with a strange task: taking up a sword and subduing her husband as he sleepwalks. Can she fulfill her duties and help her new husband find peace from his trauma?

(Source: WEBTOON)

2. P Katsu wo Nameta Mesugaki (P活を舐めたメスガキ); COMIC Mugen Tensei 2024-05

208706.description:
Se-I Lim spends time with her mother, Hye-Jeong, at Taeseung Mall, where they meet Myeong-Hyeon, the mall’s CEO. Myeong-Hyeon asks Se-I to tutor her son, Seung-Hyo. However, Se-I accidentally walks in on Seung-Ju, Seung-Hyo’s older brother, naked. Seung-Ju accuses Se-I of being a pervert, but Myeong-Hyeon doesn’t believe him. Seung-Ju insists Se-I is the only one who has seen him naked, and Myeong-Hyeon, confused, wonders if Seung-Ju might be gay. Concerned, Myeong-Hyeon asks Se-I to investigate Seung-Ju for three months. Will Se-I uncover the truth?

(Source: WEBTOON)

My Mom's Friend's Son: Observation Log
อันตรายลูกชายเพื่อนแม่

208708.description:
A booklet included inside Harta volume 131 of one full-color chapter of Hakumei to Mikochi.

The booklet features the popular Hakumei to Mikochi chapter Hajirai to Yosooi in a full-color “all-natural-color edition.” Supervised by author Kashiki, it was finished by a studio known for its meticulous coloring. Enjoy this story in color, where the usually boyish Hakumei is persuaded by Mikochi to wear cute clothes.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: ハクメイとミコチ「恥じらいと装い」
title.romaji: Hakumei to Mikochi: Hajirai to Yosooi
