208710.description:
One day, the Literature Club lends out its chairs to other clubs, leaving only a single chair behind.

Shou and Yuzu are the only two left in the clubroom, and they end up in a lighthearted argument over who should sit in the remaining chair. Each wants the other to take the seat, and neither is willing to back down out of kindness. In the end, Yuzu gets her way, and Shou is forced to sit in the chair alone.

Shou feels bad about being the only one sitting... until a sudden idea strikes him.

“If I’m sitting in the chair, then I can become the chair and let Senpai Yuzu sit on my lap, right?”

Or so he thinks.
synonyms: After I Let The Small And Cute Intellectual Senior Of The Literature Club Sit On My Lap, She Started Sitting There Every Day

title.native: 小さくて可愛い文芸部の知的な先輩を、膝の上に乗せたら毎日座ってくるようになった
title.romaji: Chiisakute Kawaii Bungei-bu no Chitekina Senpai wo, Hiza no Ue ni Nosetara Mainichi Suwatte kuru You ni Natta

208711.description: Chizuru experiences a variety of strange experiences at school and in town.

208712.description: Stories about the lives of prostitutes in Yoshiwara.

208713.description:
Not Momotaro. Momomaro. Inspired by the fairytale.

"Youkai, foxes, tanukis, and demons. This is the heavenly punishment for these freakish demons!!" The monster hunt travelogue of a young onmyouji.

Momomaro, a user of shikigamke, takes on strange supernatural phenomena with his partner Dorori! A full-color book of a great adventure and hunting action story published in The Horror (Kadokawa Shoten).

1. Kubi Yakata (首館, The Mansion of Heads)
A mother and daughter living in a secluded mansion, a wicked scheme to transform into monsters under the guise of a one-night favor.

2. Shikabanejou no Majushitsu (屍城の魔術師, The Magician in the Corpse Castle)
A magician's plot to revive a dead princess with black magic in order to spread the faith in Satan, the demon king.

3. Karakuri-Hime (からくり姫, Automated Doll Princess)
Taking shelter from the rain, a magnificent and terrifying mechanical doll awaits in an abandoned house built on a cliff.

4. Daidarabocchi (大堕羅法師, Daidarabocchi)
It is said that at a mysterious temple, girls are offered as human sacrifices to Daidarabocchi.

208714.description:
Rebecca stays with a wealthy family, the Kinrosses, to write a biography of the great actress Fiona Kinross. However, her work doesn't make much progress because of Fiona's younger brother, Stewart, who is also the head of the family. He keeps making unwanted advances and distracting Rebecca from her work. Despite her indifference to him and his fortune, people around her believe that she's a gold digger, especially Stewart's son, Brod, who doesn't hide his animosity toward her. There seems to be a deep hatred between the father and son. But when he looks at her, Rebecca also senses burning, irresistible lust in Brod's eyes!

(Source: Renta!)

208715.description:
Simon, the billionaire owner of a shopping mall franchise, is confounded when he is informed that he has a child. He's had plenty of one-night stands, but he never expected to be identified as the father by a woman he's never met before! Her name is Tula, and her cousin, who passed away, was the mother of the child, and she named Simon as the father. It is now Tula's responsibility to decide whether Simon is fit to be the father of the baby. Tula moves in with Simon, who is drawn by her mysterious charm, but no one would have guessed that Tula is also the daughter of his enemy...

(Source: Renta!)

208716.description:
Chloe, a secretary, was ecstatic when she decided to marry her boss, Lorenzo, a member of a Venetian noble house. This interclass marriage seemed to Chloe like something out of a dream. On the day of the wedding, her heart swelling and her eyes watering, she finally told Lorenzo, "I love you." But when he heard those words, his expression changed completely. Instead of returning her love, he insisted that their marriage was nothing more than a pragmatic transaction. But if that was so, then why was he so sweet and caring during their courtship? And, filled with despair after the ceremony, what could Chloe do but flee his mansion?

(Source: Renta!)

208717.description:
"Young Lanna is the daughter of the world's foremost multimillionaire, and because of that fact, she finds that all of the men who approach her are disgusting. She just wants to go somewhere where nobody knows who she is, and to finally meet somebody who will love her for her, not for her father's wealth. Enter Arash, an exchange student come to study at a British university. with purple eyes and a mysterious appearance, she believes that he's her destined love. However, it turns out that he's actually a prince from a desert country. Since their worlds are so different he tries to stop seeing her, but finds that he cannot free himself of his feelings for her. War arises in his homeland and he's called back. with no time left, they spend one last night together. ""Love me,"" she says to him. But the next morning he leaves in a cold and distant manner! What has happened?

(Source: Renta!)

208718.description:
In 1812, more than one hundred years before the Russian revolution, there was a youthful Russian Army captain, beautiful and proud. Blue-eyed Alex, a favorite of the tsar, is accompanying him to England. But Alex is a woman-born into the nobility, she ran away from home when forced to marry. Since then she has pretended to be a man. But when she meets the bright Duke Calder in England, she falls in love. Is it time for Alex to reveal her true self?

(Source: Renta!)

208719.description:
For the first time in thirteen years, Rosemary runs into Willis, her former classmate, and is shocked at how he's changed. Back in high school she was attractive and popular, and Rosemary wrote off Willis as a scrawny nerd who was only good at studying. Now, he's a professor at an acclaimed university and has come back to her village to observe a passing comet...and she can't help but observe his stellar body. During his stay in the village, he'll be sleeping over at Rosemary's house. Will more than the comet be keeping him up at night?

(Source: Renta!)

208720.description:
Overnight, Lana finds herself plunged from the height of marital bliss to the depths of despair. Her husband, Kyle, and his mistress are in a car crash, killing Kyle in an instant. His mistress is on the brink of death, and in her last month of pregnancy. To make matters worse, Kyle's last will and testament names Lana as the baby's godmother. Lana spends her days hounded by the paparazzi and her nights overcome with grief. It's then that she meets Raffaele Rossellini, a handsome young millionaire who offers her a helping hand. She's taken in by his warmth and generosity, unaware of his true identity: he's the older brother of Kyle's mistress! With a passionate kiss, he sets his plot for revenge in motion.

(Source: Renta!)

208721.description:
It's a field day for the tabloids when famous young media heiress Larissa Whitney's fiance dumps her in broad daylight in the streets of New York. But there was never any love between them; she'd only gotten engaged to him to get back at her father. To escape the watchful eyes of the paparazzi, she makes her way to a small island resort in Maine. It's there that she meets Jack, the heir of a wealthy family and, if you believed the rumors, a notorious playboy. Drawn together by their shared experience being hounded by the tabloids, they share a night of romance. Weeks later at Christmastime, Larissa finds herself alone in New York despairing that no one can see the real her, only the lies and scandals. Little does she know she's about to get a helping hand from her old flame Jack!

(Source: Renta!)

208722.description: Rize was married to her co-worker until she caught him cheating on her. She decides she'll focus on her career as a manager at a department store until her cute younger coworker starts sweeting on her. Will Rize be able to find love so immediately after divorce?

title.native: プレミア・リマリッジ

208723.description:
Shido Yukari is the granddaughter of a political don. Her life is in danger every day, and her bodyguard is a dangerous man with a terrible mouth and attitude!?

A proud young lady and a foul-mouthed, skilled bodyguard. The obsessive love story between these two, who are terribly incompatible, begins!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

208724.description:
After finishing her life as a human, Saika is reborn as a fairy in the world of immortals. However, she is unable to adapt to the world of immortals, so when she descends to the human world, a man suddenly appears. This man, Kouzen, whose life was saved by Saika when he was a boy, declares, "I will never leave your side for the rest of my life"!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: 霞の花は蒼にほどける
title.romaji: Kasumi no Hana wa Ao ni Hodokeru

208725.description:
Eileen has been forced to work as Rick's secretary at the behest of her grandmother, and it's driving her crazy. She used to have a crush on him, but he only teased her about her big eyes. She doesn't want to feel like that anymore. Now he's grown and handsome, but she won't be fooled again-though it'll be hard to keep her head when she has to spend the whole weekend working with him...

(Source: Renta!)

208726.description:
Meredith can't believe it. Who would have thought that a girl who grew up in the slums could be dancing at the palace? The dance studio founded by Meredith to teach poor girls how to dance has been invited to perform at the spring festival, and it includes a special dance with the prince. During her lesson with him, she is overwhelmed by seeing a member of royalty up close for the first time, but she also notices something. The prince never shows his emotions. But dance is something that comes from the heart. Desiring to open up his heart, Meredith disguises the prince and sneaks him out of the palace!

(Source: Renta!)

208727.description:
Tsugumi spends day after day being run ragged by work. One day, she’s involved in a traffic accident, and when she comes to, she finds herself at the Sanzu River. There, a mysterious child named "Hanako" invites her to go crayfish fishing...!?

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.english: I Tried Crayfish Fishing at the Sanzu River
title.native: 三途の川でザリガニ釣ってみた。
title.romaji: Sanzu no Kawa de Zarigani Tsuttemita.

208728.description:
Sakuto Somei is a third-year middle school student. She likes her classmate, Yoh, but she can only watch him from afar... But she plans to confess her feelings after the graduation ceremony! ...But then she gets into an accident and is transported back to the world of one year ago!? A time-traveling love story that happens on the last day of middle school!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

208729.description:
The golden age of dungeon conquest! Studio Dungeon Investment, where you buy dungeons and rake in profits, has been all the rage. The protagonist, aiming to build his wealth, bought one himself, but...?

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.native: ワンルームダンジョン投資

208730.description:
Zhou Jincheng, who lost his eyesight in a family massacre, embarked on a path of vengeance alongside the young girl Lingling after training a wolf to serve as his guide dog.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.native: ゴーストラブライター

208732.description:
Roella Brietta is a fake saint destined to be replaced by the real deal, until a mysterious system traps her in a forced redemption route: raise her reputation or die trying. She plans to lay low, but her reluctant good deeds keep being mistaken for real power. Things spiral further when the crown prince, tormented by a secret curse, realizes her touch can ease his pain. Now, with her quiet plan slipping out of control, Roella had better watch her mouth... because the system is always listening!

(Source: Tapas)

208734.description:
Mirumo confronts a crisis that befalls the fairy world. After completing his training in the human world, Mirumo returns to the fairy world and leads a busy yet fulfilling life. One day, a mysterious black cloud appears in the fairy world and attacks the fairies. In the midst of the chaos, Mirumo's wife, Rirumu, is kidnapped...

The story follows Mirumo's struggle to get Rirumu back, alongside his rival Yashichi and his younger brother Murumo.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

208735.description:
The uninhabited island of ‘Hidden Peak Island’, rendered desolate by a volcanic eruption. A group arrives to survey this long-abandoned island, seeking to exploit it for business ventures. An ethnology research lab, a resort company, a video content creator— What awaited these pioneers seeking the untouched peak was a ‘monster’ more terrifying than hell itself...

No escape, no way to call for help. Can they truly escape this isolated island where only death awaits?

(Source: Nihon Bungeisha, translated)

208736.description: Sarasa, a 10-year-old fashion-loving girl, casts a spell to wish she "became an adult!" and a sparkling fairy appears, transforming her into an 18-year-old...?!

208737.description:
This charming yuri manga follows two time travellers with an eye for fashion, journeying across eras in search of the most beautiful garments history has to offer. From forgotten wardrobes to dazzling period couture, their adventures weave together style, history, and a budding romance.

(Source: Crossed Hearts)

Note: Released at COMITIA143, 149

title.native: タイムイズアクローゼット: 死者のウエディングドレス
title.romaji: Time Is a Closet: Shisha no Wedding Dress

208738.description:
Former detective Iijima, who retired after being shot and injured by a barricaded criminal, is currently staying at his colleague Tsukioka's house. To repay the favor, he cooks meals every day. One morning, after learning Tsukioka's favorite food is soft-boiled eggs, Iijima suggests “Fluffy and Creamy Omelette Rice” for dinner. Tsukioka is overjoyed and declares, “I'll definitely leave work on time!” But...!?

(Source: Homesha, machine translated)

title.native: 悪役令嬢は嫌なので、医務室助手になりました。
title.romaji: Akuyaku Reijou wa Iya na node, Imushitsu Joshu ni Narimashita.

208740.description:
"I was a villainess…" One day, Layla Vivienne woke up and remembered that she was a Japanese person in her previous life and is now a rival character inside a romance game. In that game, Layla Vivienne had been engaged to the crown prince, one of the romance options. She didn't bully the heroine, but she was an unlucky character who ended up dying in every route except her older brother's. She wanted to avoid dying, so she came up with the idea of avoiding entering the magic academy where the game was set as a student. Layla chose to enter the academy as a doctor's assistant and tried to avoid both the romantic options and the heroine, but unfortunately…

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)
synonyms: Akuyaku Reijo ha Iyananode Imushitsu Joshu ni Narimashita
악역 영애가 싫어서 의무실 조수가 됐습니다

title.english: I Don't Want to Be a Villainess, so I Became a Doctor's Assistant
title.native: 悪役令嬢は嫌なので、医務室助手になりました。
title.romaji: Akuyaku Reijou wa Iya na node, Imushitsu Joshu ni Narimashita.

208741.description:
Five years ago, Mahiru's best friend Yukinojou stole her magical powers, leading her to Heliogabalus, a special magic academy at the forefront of magical research.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: まひると薔薇の魔法論
目黒から目が離せない！
桃宮くんは無自覚です

208744.description:
The story is based on the Fashion Koshien (National High School Fashion Design Championship) held in Hirosaki, Aomori Prefecture. Ariake Momo, a gal who grew up in a snowy area, meets Ujyou Ren, a boy her age who aspires to be a designer, and they try their hand at making clothes to express the "cute" that only they can find inside of them. Momo and Ren then team up to aim to win the Fashion Koshien.

(Source: Natalie, translated)
synonyms: Gyaru to Couture: Ariake Momo wa Fuku wo Tsukutte Yuushou suru Koto ni shita

title.native: ギャルとクチュール～有明モモは服を作って優勝することにした～
title.romaji: Gal to Couture: Ariake Momo wa Fuku wo Tsukutte Yuushou suru Koto ni shita

208745.hashtag: #ヤンキーに恋と育児はムズすぎるR

title.native: ヤンキーに恋と育児はムズすぎるR
title.romaji: Yankee ni Koi to Ikuji wa Muzu sugiru R

208746.description: A boy named Kang Gae-to enters the Union of the Cross, where only geniuses can enter, thanks to a gift. Kang Gae-to, who went to school in a uniform he only wore on special occasions from day one, became a key figure at the school with all kinds of eccentricities.

208747.description:
A monthly meeting for high school girls who are awkward when it comes to love, known as the Love Club! Five girls who want to do their best in love and love melodramatic stories more than anything else, will be sharing their most thrilling melodramatic stories today!!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: 恋部は今日もメロエピトークが止まらない！
title.romaji: Koi-bu wa Kyou mo Melo-epi Talk ga Tomaranai!

title.native: 巻き戻しラブアタック

208750.description: The legend of the hero of the legend... I can't escape this never-ending loop!
synonyms: The Legend Of The Hero Of The Legend Of The Hero Of The Legend

title.native: 伝説の勇者の伝説の勇者の伝説
title.romaji: Densetsu no Yuusha no Densetsu no Yuusha no Densetsu

208751.description:
All because of one little lie, one night turned into something more...?! A secret love between Nazuna and her boss!

Mr. Ichijo not only excels at work, but he's handsome to boot. Every woman in the company has their eyes on him. I'm no exception, but I've already resigned myself to the sidelines. Although I had given up, after a work party, we were both swept up in the moment and ended up spending the night together!

The next morning, to hide my feelings for him, I lied and told him I didn't need a boyfriend! I thought he'd think little of me, but instead, he suggested we...?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: I Don't Need a Boyfriend Right Now (That's a Lie)
title.native: いま彼氏とかいらなくて（ウソ）

208753.description:
The world’s first full-dive VRMMO, Sword Art Online—known as SAO. What was meant to be a dream come true has instead transformed into a deadly game where dying in the virtual world means dying in reality.

Emirun and Rex, who once knew each other in the real world, reunite by chance within SAO. They join a scouting party to learn how to survive in this unforgiving world. One day, however, they encounter a mysterious PK (Player Killer) known only as the Black Swordsman. When Emirun rushes to the scene, she finds Rex collapsed in despair, and the Black Swordsman standing over him. The one who wiped out their entire scouting party—was the Black Swordsman.

Determined to avenge their fallen comrades, Emirun and Rex seek out the legendary prodigy swordswoman Asuna, and begin intense training under her guidance. In a death game where even players turn against one another, what new beginning will these two reach at the end of their struggle…?

(Source: Official Site, translated)

208756.description: Note: Originally self-published on Twitter and Pixiv, was then licensed by Printemps Shuppan for serialization.

synonyms: I fell in love with the light of Sunrise

title.native: 日の出の光に恋をした
title.romaji: Hinode no Hikari ni Koi wo Shita

208758.description: Note: Originally published as a one-shot in Lynx 2025 March issue under the title "Reward and Punishing (リワードアンドパニッシング)", was then picked up for serialization.
synonyms: リワードアンドパニッシング

title.native: リワードアンドパニッシュメント

208759.hashtag: #不器用リスタートスケッチ

title.native: 不器用リスタートスケッチ

208761.hashtag: #その恋入れかえ不可能です

title.native: その恋入れかえ不可能です！

208762.description:
Fictionalized retelling of the historic incident wherein a band of lordless samurai avenged their fallen master.

Note: This edition is a revised version of the series that was known as Goseki Chushingura

208763.description:
Drawing with lines that combine the expressive and kinetic energy of Yuichi Yokoyama’s neo-manga with a stylistic looseness and freshness, and a fascination for the interplay of the domains of human and nature often portrayed in the works of Gao Yan and Tsung-Hsien Xue, Arisaka establishes herself as working in a completely modern idiom.

(Source: Glacier Bay Books)

Note: The English edition credited only Ayumu Arikawa of Saigo no Shudan as the author.

208764.description:
Notes:
- During serialization, Chapters 1 to 3 were split into three parts while Chapters 4 to 16 were split into five parts.
- Includes six extra chapters.

title.native: インスタントボーイフレンド

208765.description:
A comic work by the video team Saigo no Shudan—comprising Ayumu Arisaka, Mai Oita, and Ren Kohata—known for music videos for EVISBEATS, Akiko Yano, YUKI. Their mission: to awaken humanity's primordial memories.

En-chan, a five-year-old absorbed in her daydreams, gets caught in a natural disaster at a convenience store and time-shifts back to when she was one year old. With immense vitality and imagination, she leads Earth toward destruction while simultaneously opening up a new world!

This work took nine years to complete: three years of conceptualization, three years of illustration, and three years to publish the book.

(Source: Saigo no Shudan, translated)

Note: This edition was self-published with nearly double the number of pages of the original web release.

208767.description:
There is a convenience store clerk who is always so nice to everyone.
I thought I would be satisfied to just see her smile every day…!?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

Note: Originally published in Margaret 2026 Issue No. 2.
synonyms: There's an angel at that convenience store.

title.native: あのコンビニには天使がいる
title.romaji: Ano Konbini ni wa Tenshi ga Iru

title.native: 私のこと絶対大好きじゃん！
title.romaji: Watashi no Koto Zettai Daisuki jan!

synonyms: Joudan de Onna Yuusha-tachi wo Kudoita Daimaou, Sarawarete Kyousei Shinkon Seikatsu

title.native: 冗談で女勇者たちを口説いた大魔王、攫われて強制新婚生活
title.romaji: Joudan de Onna Yuushatachi wo Kudoita Daimaou, Sarawarete Kyousei Shinkon Seikatsu

208771.description:
Caomei is a lowly lady-in-waiting in the imperial court. Aside from her daily task of plucking weeds, she possesses a special talent: styling flowers.

These “healing flowers” bloom atop a woman’s head as a living symbol of her dignity—as precious to them as life itself. While Caomei once dreamed of becoming a certified floral stylist, she abandoned that hope long ago.

But when a high-ranking concubine arrives with her flowers in severe decay, she begs Caomei for help. Armed with her intricate styling techniques and the mysterious power of her own flowers, Caomei’s forgotten gift might just hold the key to saving the entire imperial court…?!

(Source: Manga UP! Global)

208772.description:
Anastasia's engagement is called off by her parents and the engagement party that was supposed to take place on her birthday is suddenly turned into an engagement party for her sister Laura and her fiancé Nikolai. Of course, she has to attend the party, too... Before she knows it, the school has found out about the engagement. Anastasia is humiliated and shocked, but Lewis, a junior student proposes a fake engagement between the two! Anastasia, no longer afraid of anything after experiencing a broken engagement and the pity of others, becomes desperate and plans to crash the engagement party with her fake engagement announcement.

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: I Faked an Engagement to a Duke's Son Because My Sister Stole My Fiancé.
title.native: 妹に婚約者を略奪されたので、公爵家の後輩と偽装婚約したら何故か溺愛されています。
title.romaji: Imouto ni Konyakusha wo Ryakudatsusareta no de, Koushaku-ke na Kouhai to Gisou Konyaku shitara Naze ka Dekiaisareteimasu.

208773.description:
1. Houkago Love Connection (放課後ラブコネクション)
2. Houkago Love Connection 2: Mukashi no Otoko (放課後ラブコネクション 2　昔の男)
3. Joumaeya ★ Lock (錠前屋★ロック)
4. Kamisama wa Miteru dake. (かみさまはみてるだけ。)
5. Yuunagi (夕凪)
6. Tokio-chan to Kirakiraboshi (トキオちゃんとキラキラ星)

title.native: クラスごと異世界転移したら、僕だけ夜の経験値でレベルアップする件
title.romaji: Class-goto Isekai Teni shitara, Boku Dake Yoru no Keikenchi de Level Up suru Ken

title.native: 追放された不遇職『色使い』が世界を塗り替えるまで ～美少女だらけのSランクパーティーで最強スキルの本当の使い方を知り無双する～
title.romaji: Tsuihou sareta Fuguushoku "Irotsukai" ga Sekai Sekai wo Nurikaeru made: Bishoujo darake no S Rank Party de Saikyou Skill wo Hontou no Tsukaikata wo Shiri Musou suru

title.native: ドスケベ催眠術師の子

synonyms: A Reincarnated Former Slave Forms the Ultimate Harem with the Cheat Skill "Myriad Forms"

title.native: 転生した元奴隷、チートスキル『千変万化』で最強ハーレムを作る
title.romaji: Tensei shita Moto Dorei, Cheat Skill "Senpenbanka" de Saikyou Harem wo Tsukuru

208779.description:
Daichi Fumita, a middle-aged man being treated as an ATM by his wife, daughter, and even his subordinates at work, meets an untimely end. Reincarnated into another world, Daichi has been granted the "support" skill by the goddess, a skill only granted to those who have worked hard for others. However, due to the power of the buffs it confers, he is again treated as an ATM in the other world and flees.
Daichi opens a pub in a distant land and finally achieves a stable life. Then one day, Meltina, a girl who is a regular at the pub, arrives in tatters, saying, "I'm going to be sold to a brothel." After hearing her plight, Daichi decides to use the "support" skill that he had sealed away for so long...!?

(Source: Kill Time Communication, translated)

title.native: ATMおじさん　異世界でモテ期が止まらない！
title.romaji: ATM Oji-san: Isekai de Moteki ga Tomaranai!

title.native: 勇者パーティを追い出された器用貧乏 外伝 オフのセルマさんは不器用!?
title.romaji: Yuusha Party wo Oidasareta Kiyoubinbou Gaiden: Off no Selma-san wa Bukiyou!?

208782.description:
"Sakurako, this is a contract..."

In Shimanokuni, an autonomous region of Japan where supernatural powers are revered. In this land where everyone can use supernatural powers, Sakurako, the daughter of a baron, is "powerless." Compared to her younger sister, who possesses more powerful supernatural powers, she is treated worse than a servant and oppressed every day. With no hope for the future and nowhere to go, one day, a girl with no place to belong receives a marriage proposal from Nioroji Shizuma, the most feared supernatural power user of the time. He has pale skin and scarlet eyes, and is the most beautiful man she has ever seen... Sakurako is confused that she, a powerless person, was chosen instead of her sister, but Shizuma tells her that this is a contract marriage for the purpose of a "certain power" that only Sakurako, who is supposed to be powerless, possesses. A Japanese-style Cinderella story in which two lonely people, connected by contract, are drawn to each other!

(Source: Starts Publishing, translated)

208783.description:
Sibel, the daughter of a count, has her engagement broken off by the prince for bullying her stepsister, who is apparently a true saint. Furthermore, she is banished to a remote area where monsters run rampant, and ends up working in the dormitory of the First Knights, who are protecting the area... However, in fact, Sibel loves knights with well-trained muscles! She went to the frontier with great joy, and now she is surrounded by the knights she admires, living a happy and joyful life as a dorm mother. There, she meets Leo, the commander of the knights, and begins to develop feelings for the humble and dedicated Sibel...!?　 What will become of the love between the innocent, carefree saint Sibel and the equally innocent Leo, who makes mistakes every day?

A dream life surrounded by the perfect muscles! A life of cohabitation that will make you faint!

(Source: Comic Pash, translated)

title.native: 追放された騎士好き聖女は今日も幸せ
title.romaji: Tsuihou Sareta Kishizuki Seijo wa Kyou mo Shiawase

208784.description:
"Miss Alicia Fontania. Please marry me."

Alicia, the daughter of a duke, realizes that she has been reincarnated as the villainous young lady from a novel she loved in her previous life. She does her best to avoid the flags, but she ends up being executed for the crime of trying to murder the princess, who is loved by the crown prince, out of jealousy! However, at the moment of her execution, Friedrich, the commander of the knights who had held Alicia captive until then, knelt down and proposed marriage! He had called her a corrupt young lady so many times, so what is he saying now? I firmly reject this proposal! Alicia refused, but Friedrich suddenly turned around and repeatedly confessed that he loved her...!? With the handsome commander of the knights doting on her, will the corrupt young lady be able to avoid ruin this time?

(Source: Ohzora Publishing)

title.native: 悪徳令嬢に転生したのに、まさかの求婚!?～手のひら返しの求婚はお断りします！～
title.romaji: Akutoku Reijou ni Tensei shita no ni, Masaka no Kyuukon!?: Tenohira-gaeshi no Kyuukon wa Okotowarishimasu!

title.native: 仕事のあとは同じ教室で
title.romaji: Shigoto no Ato wa Onaji Kyoushitsu de

208787.description:
This is the last stronghold for those who are unable to find a partner... One day, Sekiguchi Makoto, who has lost his job and been dumped by his girlfriend, meets Butsumetsu Seishiro, the president of the Butsumetsu Marriage Agency, and decides to join the company. He thinks it's a noble job that makes people happy, but in reality it's a place to take in "marriage refugees" who are covered in lies...!?

(Source: Comiplex, translated)

title.native: ハッピーこれから百合になるバレンタインデー
title.romaji: Happy Korekara Yuri ni Naru Valentine Day

title.native: 享年82歳の異世界転生!?〜ハズレ属性でも、スキルだけで無双します〜
title.romaji: Kyounen 82-sai no Isekai Tensei!? - Hazure Zokusei Demo, Skill Dake de Musou Shimasu

208790.description:
A corporate slave who died from overwork finds himself in a new world, treated as cannon fodder by the Goddess and a "must-kill" enemy by the Demon Lord. Even his very first identity in this world is... a dog.

With a strategy to first kill the Goddess and then trick the Demon Lord, he must utilize the five years before the Gods revive to become the Master of the World and change his destiny of certain death. And his starting point? The Imperial Tax Bureau—a place even dogs wouldn't go

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: Overtime Salaryman Reincarnates as a Hero
Wo Zai Yi Jie Dang Zougou

title.english: Starting Off By Surrendering to the Demon Lord
title.native: 残業サラリーマン、勇者に転生する
title.romaji: Zankyou Salaryman, Yuusha ni Tensei Suru

208791.description:
At a remarkably young age, Choi Mu-Jin has already ascended to the prestigious position of second-in-command within the notorious national syndicate, 'Weolha Organization.' While he is a figure of intense envy and admiration among his subordinates, Mu-Jin carries a burden no one else suspects, a hidden, degrading mission assigned by the Chairman himself. Every week under the cover of darkness, he is sent to extract semen from Baek Wu-Yeon, the Chairman’s secluded ""human talisman"" kept hidden away from the world.

Inside the suffocating luxury of a high-end penthouse, the command is always the same: ""Suck it."" The moment Wu-Yeon’s lips part, Mu-Jin’s autonomy vanishes entirely. Faced with an order he is powerless to refuse, Mu-Jin finds himself trapped in a cycle of duty and desire. Can he successfully carry out his visceral task tonight, or will the weight of this secret finally break him?

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: 液祓い〜ペントハウスのその中で〜

208792.description:
With the Earth engulfed in an epic Revival of Spiritual Energy, Maximillian Lin and his friends are left for dead in the aftermath of a cruel betrayal. Before his last breath is drawn, Max awakens the mysterious Spiritual Cultivation System, which sends him hurtling back in time to a world still on the brink of its Spiritual Revival. With vengeance in his heart, Max finds himself with a unique knowledge of the future that just might help him avoid his past mistakes, save his friends, and rise to the Peak of Spiritual Cultivation!

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: After Being Reincarnated, I Will Reach the Top With My Divergent Cheats
When I Reincarnated, I Stood at the Top with Supernatural Cheats

title.english: Reborn with Might: Spearhead to the Zenith

208793.description:
"I want you to marry me," Rebecca says to Will, who is rumored to be a gold-digging con artist. She needs a husband for show because she is desperately trying to put a stop to the ongoing marriage offers brought upon her as a result of inheriting a massive estate. The sudden proposal by the "Ice Lady," who is known to keep away from men, is quite a surprise for Will, but he is also grateful for her offer to pay off his late father's debts. He could flourish in the elite class of London and wipe away the image of him before he was about to get arrested. The great marriage fraud has begun...

(Source: MangaPlaza)

208794.description:
Sold by his debt-ridden father to the Cavertia Ducal House, Ashe was content with his new life as a slave. But his peaceful days come to an end when he suddenly presents as an omega. Thrown into the bedroom of Duke Opelta Cavertia—his master, a notorious alpha with rumors of ruthless and sadistic treatment towards omegas, he finds himself dragged into a private “training” regime. Caught between embarrassment and overwhelming pleasure, how long can this innocent slave survive the intoxicating dominance of the Duke?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Part of Daiwon's Neungyonk BL Danpyeon (능욕BL단편) Collection.
synonyms: [Neungyok BL Danpyeon] Geu Gongjakga Noyeui Eumnanhan Soksajeong
The Obscene Secrets of That Duke's Slave

title.english: The Lewd Secret Of The Duke's Slave

208795.description:
Afraid of love, Phoebe made a decision. In order to find the person she's meant to be with, she has to get used to intimacy with men. She has to find Mr. Right Now! Playboy Pace perfectly fits the bill for this goal. He's manly, dangerously sexy and has an unbearably charming smile. Due to some unexpected circumstances, he accompanies Phoebe on a long drive back to her hometown. This is her chance to get closer to him. Heart pounding, Phoebe takes it upon herself to sweetly seduce him. She soon wonders if Pace might actually be her true love...but Pace is hiding a shocking secret!

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: シンデレラを愛した大富豪

208796.description:
Gina's job has brought her all the way to the desert kingdom of Kabuyadir, a place where, once upon a time, she spent a magical night with a strapping man by the name of Zahir. While they promised to see each other again one day, Gina was unable to believe in her long-distance sweetheart's vows of love, so she broke things off. Now she's returned to appraise the Heart of Courage, a jewel passed down through the Kabuyadir royal family along with the prophecy that all members of the royal family will forever live only for love. And who should arrive to welcome Gina to the palace but Zahir himself! Never in her wildest dreams would Gina have imagined that Zahir was a king! Has he called her here to get revenge for dumping him all those years ago?

(Source: Renta!)

208797.description:
Nicole's younger twin sister was a beautiful, bright woman who was loved by all. But she died leaving a son by a shipping tycoon, Rafe Medici. Three years have passed since then, and now an unbelievably gorgeous man, who shakes with anger, stands before Nicole. This is the first time she's met a man of the Medici family. After finding out about his child, who her younger sister secretly gave birth to, he comes to collect him. The rumors of him were true and he arrogantly tells her to quit her job in order to raise his child in Miami as a part of his family...

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: メディチ兄弟は罪作り

208798.description:
India was born into a noble family in decline. At a party she jokingly says she should marry a rich man. At that moment she meets a wealthy business man named Aidan and falls madly in love, forgetting all about the joke. However, on their wedding day, Aidan rejects her vows and leaves her at the altar. Then one year later he appears again, saying he wants India as a repayment for her father's debt! India is confused and angry but she cannot refuse his charms...

(Source: Renta!)

208799.description:
At the rugby match, where the new uniforms she designed made their debut, Tamsin finds herself reunited with Alejandro, the man she's destined for. Six years ago, she had unrequited feelings for the star rugby player. But he misunderstood and thought she had seduced him into a trap that got him kicked off the team. Now he's a successful businessman and a sponsor for the opposing team. But despite his success, she can still see the contempt in his eyes. Why have they reunited like this? Have they been eternally bound by his hatred?

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 再会は憎しみに満ちて

208800.description:
A matchmaking system that synthesizes all data to introduce you to the perfect partner. But sometimes the matched couple have… “complications”!? An episodic series depicting love that begins with data!

(Source: Flower Comics, translated)

title.native: データはきみだと言うけれど

208801.description:
Kim Dan, a rising baseball prospect on the verge of going pro, is suddenly thrown into a world overrun by monsters, armed only with his bat and the mysterious creature lurking inside it. Before long, he forms a strange symbiotic relationship with the being, which devours the monsters he defeats and grants him overwhelming power in return. With no way home in sight, Dan must grow stronger by taking down deadlier creatures, one swing at a time. Batter up, monsters. Dan doesn’t plan to miss.

(Source: Tapas)

208802.description:
Up-and-coming interior designer Lucinda is dumped by her fiance and develops a mistrust of men. When she gets a job offer to renovate a luxurious mansion on the island of Saint Lucia in the Caribbean Sea, it's a dream come true! But there's a problem with her employer. It's Zane Alexander?a man for whom she once had feelings! He's the last person in the world she wants to be around right now. But as soon as they arrive at the island, he invites her to spend her time there as a vacation...with him.

(Source: Renta!)

208803.description:
Emmeline, the Queen of Brabant, asks her friend Hannah to switch places with her for a few hours. Her objective is to ask her lover, Alejandro, to take responsibility for a certain matter. But when she sees him at a nightclub, he treats her like dirt, and Makin, who is Sheikh of Kadar and also Hannah's boss, goes over and talks to her. She mustn't let him find out her true identity! With an aggravated look on his face, he forcefully takes Emmeline away from the nightclub.

(Source: Renta!)

208804.description:
Legendary Authors Lee Hyun-se and Lee Doo-ho Present: A Short Story Collection by New Writers Now in Its Sixth Season!

(Source: Naver, translated)

Stories Included:
1. Blossom (Blossom) [Lipillar]
2. Ileobeorin (잃어버린) [Yumapa]
3. Jiokchyeoltu (지옥쳘투) [Yeongyeon]
4. Giriningan (기린인간) [Hyeong-Chan Kim]
5. Sonyeosyap (소녀샵) [Ji-Su Yu]
6. Jikso (직소) [Han-Ui Kim]
7. Yomul Agassi (요물 아가씨) [Dong-Hyeon Kim]
8. Doedori Gogae (되돌이 고개) [Eun-Ji Hong]
9. LIMBO (LIMBO) [Dae-Hong Sin]
10. Biwol (비월) [Buchu]
11. Dokkaebibul (도깨비불) [Mun-Ju Kim]
12. Neowa Naui Gyunhyeong (너와 나의 균형) [SORU]
13. Annyeong (안녕) [Min-Jin Kang]

208805.description:
Brook is shocked when one day her younger sister,Courtney,announces that she will be getting married to her boyfriend,Jeff. However,the two of them are still in high school. "As her older sister,I must put a stop to this reckless marriage!" When Brook consults with Jeff's cool and handsome older stepbrother,Chase,he throws her a $10,000 check,saying bluntly that "I'd like to pretend none of this ever happened"! Shaking with anger that he has insulted her sister by saying she's only after money,she ends up slapping him in a burst of outrage!

(Source: Renta!)
synonyms: パーソナル・タッチ！　III

208806.description:
Secretary Jane has been in love with Charles, the CEO, for three years. One day, Jane receives an order from Charles to put out a personal ad in a magazine addressed to a "Holly Baskin." Could Holly be his ex-girlfriend...? Jane is still reeling from the shock of the ad going to print when a statue of Cupid falls from the sky and hits her in the head, knocking her unconscious. She wakes up to find herself in a hospital bed, unable to remember anything, no matter what the doctors ask her. Then suddenly, she remembers her name: "I'm Holly...Holly Baskin."

(Source: Renta!)
synonyms: パーソナル・タッチ！　II

title.native: キューピッドのいたずら

208807.description:
Finally overcoming the hurt she experienced from her previous marriage, Emma is now a successful interior designer. However, she suddenly comes under suspicion from Zack, the older brother of her friend who introduced her to the job. "Did you get that job by sleeping with my little brother?" He knows that Emma's previous husband was a famous musician who died from a drug overdose, and he fears that his brother is her next target. "I won't be fooled... Under that frightened disguise of yours lies a wicked monster!" says Zack in an angry tone as he approaches Emma...

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 恋という名の罠に落ちて
title.romaji: Koi to iu na no Wana ni Ochite

208808.description:
Mere days before the ceremony, Nell finds out a cruel truth: her marriage is based on a contract. Her husband, a Greek business tycoon ten years her senior, purchased a virgin wife for fifty million dollars. One year later, Nell awakens in a hospital bed after a car crash only to find her husband, Xander Pascalis, there to greet her. After rejecting her on their first night together, the two have always lived apart. However, on this day, Nell sees nothing but anger on his face. "So, has your lover already tasted your forbidden fruit, when I've yet so much as laid eyes on it?"

(Source: Renta!)

208809.description:
A high-class apartment on Park Avenue looking over Manhattan. A lone working class girl amongst the high and mighty socialites, Carrie is working as a house-sitter, and she's worried. She's worried about her unstable employment and her senile mother. And about the neighbor, Trent! Every single one of the girls who visit her playboy neighbor, Trent Tanford, mistake Carrie's place for his and disturb her sleep nightly. No matter how handsome he is or how much money he has, today is the day she's going to confront him! What will happen when Carrie pays a visit on the boy next door?

(Source: Renta!)

208810.description:
The small Pacific island kingdom of Rahiri has just lost its king, and now the widowed queen, Lani, must follow tradition and marry the king's younger brother. Alun is a famous Hollywood director?and an infamous playboy, according to the tabloids. Alun's not thrilled about the arrangement, either, and coldly snubs Lani. The former king was already terrible enough to her, and now that treatment continues with the little brother, too. But when they share an impromptu kiss, Lani's body is overcome with a passion as hot as the jungle. Can she carry on this arranged marriage while hiding an unspeakable secret?

(Source: Renta!)

title.romaji: Ou to no Ai Naki Kekkon

208811.description:
No matter how much we look alike, the prince will never love me. Hannah, an American secretary, agrees to switch places with Princess Emmeline, just for two hours. There must be a reason that made her ask me for such a favor. Besides, it's only for a few hours. But Emmeline doesn't return for days, and Hannah ends up having to meet King Zale of Raguva, pretending to be the princess!

(Source: Renta!)

208812.description:
Shannon's sister, Keira, is critically injured in a car accident, the same one that killed Keira's husband, Angelo. It's Luca, Angelo's brother-and Shannon's ex-who delivers the tragic news to her in London. "Are we alone?" he asks, barging into her home and searching through it. Shannon shakes with anger, realizing that he must be looking for a man. They'd been in love two years ago, until Luca accused Shannon of cheating while he was away and broke up with her without even letting her explain. Who would have thought she'd meet him again, and like this, of all the ways?

(Source: Renta!)

208813.description: Note: Originally published in Comic Yuri-Hime Spring 2009 issue.

title.native: 悪役令嬢たちは揺るがない

208815.description: Note: Originally published in Comic Yuri-Hime Spring 2009 issue.

208816.description:
Rou is a psychologist looking for a bride for the sheik of the Kingdom of Sarq. No matter how charming she finds Sheik Zayed Fehr, she has to come up with a woman who fits his strict requirements perfectly within a week, which she admits is impossible! But Zayed seems not to care about the difficulties she's having, and when she finally produces a list of women, he rejects them all point-blank. On top of that, when he steals a kiss from her, she's overwhelmed by the heat of his intense passion. Just like that, he decides to coerce her into becoming his bride...

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: Duty, Desire and the Desert King

208817.description:
Joey, who is a lawyer, has always admired her brother-in-law, Gideon. She looks up to him as a fellow lawyer, but is attracted to him as a man. Gideon is intelligent yet sexy-my ideal man. I'm so drawn to him, but he won't accept me as a romantic companion. Perhaps I just don't have any female charms. Joey tries her best to act like a woman who is highly experienced with relationships when Gideon says the unexpected: "I think we can be great friends with benefits."

(Source: Renta!)

208818.description:
Erin is a reporter writing a "Guide to Rich Bachelors" series of articles that explores Portland's richest and handsomest men, all in the hopes of being recognized as a full-fledged writer. But the men she interviews are a bunch of worthless, arrogant womanizers. Just like her ex-husband was. The last interviewee for her series is Jared Warfield, a difficult man to get along with who despises the media, and who wears expensive brand-name shoes and watches. Of course. And yet...he's also a man who adopted and is raising the orphaned child of his late stepsister. Do such incredible men really exist?

(Source: Renta!)

208819.description:
One pre-Christmas day, Julie gets run over by a car driven by Roy Fletcher, the president of a leading IT company. He, however, offers settlement money by saying, "My car never touched you. You decided to fall off your bike. Don't even think about suing me." Unconvinced of his action, Julie goes to return the money. Wearing a cynical smile on his handsome face, he replies, "Are you trying to increase the amount?" What kind of man is he! So thinking, Julie gets captivated by this attractive man...!

(Source: Renta!)

208820.description:
Kat's husband, the late Earl of the Grange, left her with a very large amount of debt when he suddenly passed away. She's on the brink of losing everything; her family, her mansion, and her beloved home, High Farm. As this is happening, an unexpected visitor comes to pay a visit to Kat. A man named Heath, who also happens to be Kat's long, lost adopted brother! When they were young, they were secretly in love with each another but, Heath was discriminated by her jealous brother, Joseph, and the villagers because of his "gypsy" features. He left High Farm and was never seen again...Until 10 years later, when Heath has transformed into a successful, business owner and comes back to seek revenge against the people who had wronged him before...particularly Kat and her family!

(Source: Renta!)

208821.description:
"I won't let you escape this time. I've always loved you." Michelle, a nurse, has come to California to take care of Zak, her brother-in-law and a successful businessman. Zak grew up as an orphan. Seven years younger than Michelle, he was a beautiful but fickle child. But after two years, he has grown into a man who is as virile and attractive as a Greek god. With his dazzling smile, Zak openly seduces Michelle. His attitude is just the same as before, but now poses a dangerous temptation for Michelle. "I knew the day would come when I couldn't resist his allure anymore."

(Source: Renta!)

208822.description:
In the wake of the apocalyptic Red Mist, Caleb Hunt's world is reduced to two truths: his family is dead, and his sister is missing. His quest for vengeance and answers leads him to the front lines of humanity’s final stand. But Caleb is a living weapon, harboring a power born of the same source as the invading horrors. To fight them, he must become like them—devouring beasts to steal their abilities, evolving into a stronger, more monstrous version of himself with every battle. This is his sacrifice. Every step toward salvation is a step into the abyss. In a world where evolution is the only law, Caleb must choose: cling to his fading humanity, or embrace the beast within to become the strongest survivor of the end times.

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: Disaster Comes: I Evolve Into the Crimson King
Doomsday Arrival: Evolution Into the Crimson King
Le Roi de la Brume Rouge

title.english: Doomspawn: I Evolve to Ultimate Therianthrope
title.native: 灾厄降临：我进化为猩红之王
title.romaji: Zai E Jiang Lin: Wo Jinhua Wei Xinghong Zhi Wang

208823.description:
Wendy Reed wakes up to find herself inside a novel, now living as a three-and-a-half-year-old little girl. To make matters worse, she's landed in the infamous Reed family, a household doomed for destruction. To survive, Wendy must rely on her charm and cuteness to win over Logan Reed, the dangerous and unpredictable head of the family. But survival won't be easy. Her new "big brothers" are far from ordinary. They're all watching her closely and could snap at any moment. Can Wendy make it through this villain-filled nightmare with her life intact, or will her cuteness be her only way out?

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: After Becoming a Dumpling, the Villain Family All Wants to Kill Me!
After I Transmigrated Into a Cutie Pie, the Villains All Wanted to Kill Me!

title.english: Turned a Toddler: The Villain Family Wants Me Dead!
title.native: 穿成团子后，反派一家都想杀我！
title.romaji: Chuan Cheng Tuanzi Hou, Fanpai Yijia Dou Xiang Sha Wo!

title.native: 俺のやさしくない先輩

synonyms: Omae no Sei de Omega-ka Suru Nante!

title.native: おまえのせいでΩ化するなんて！
title.romaji: Omae no Sei de Ω-ka Suru Nante!

title.native: 本日も幼なじみは回り道

208839.description:
Isagi, a court alchemist, uses alchemy to promote agricultural reform in order to save the people suffering from food shortages. However, he is not understood by the country, which prioritizes military affairs, and is eventually fired. Isagi is at a loss, but at the invitation of his cat-beast maid, Mercia, he decides to head to a remote beast village! The start of a leisurely and heartwarming farming slow life for an alchemist!

(Source: Starts Publishing, translated)

title.native: 解雇された宮廷錬金術師は辺境で大農園を作り上げる～祖国を追い出されたけど、最強領地でスローライフを謳歌する〜
title.romaji: Kaikosareta Kyuutei Renkinjutsushi wa Henkyou de Dai Nouen wo Tsukuriageru: Sokoku wo Oidasareta kedo, Saikyou Ryouchi de Slow Life wo Ouka suru

208840.description: Note: Originally self-published on Twitter and Pixiv, was then licensed by Kaiohsha for commercial release.
synonyms: Will You Let Me Stay Here?

title.native: ここに居てもいいですか
title.romaji: Koko ni Ite mo Ii desu ka

synonyms: My Little Sister Was a Hostess at Class 2-C's School Festival Boobs Bar

title.native: 2年C組学園おっぱぶのキャストに妹がいた
title.romaji: 2-nen C-gumi Gakuen Oppabu no Cast ni Imouto ga Ita

title.native: ルカとなかよししませんか?

208843.description:
On his way home from a part-time job, the protagonist dies in an unfortunate accident and is reborn as a baby named Alec in a fantasy world. In his previous life, Alec was abandoned by his real mother and suffered greatly, so this time he resolves to live freely. However, he soon learns that in this life too, he is destined to be abandoned. Together with his cute younger “sister” figure, Liz—his companion in fate—Alec throws himself into intense magic training! Even when the fated day comes and he is left behind in a deep forest, he and Liz aim to escape using the magic they’ve mastered.

The two little ones eventually make it past the forest and arrive in the Hohenheim territory. There, they start their life as adventurers with the help of a kind young man named Jin, and even save a town from a massive horde of monsters, achieving great success! Meanwhile, back at his family’s home, a wicked scheme is underway…!?

(Source: AlphaPolis, translated)

title.native: 転生しても実家を追い出されたので、今度は自分の意志で生きていきます
title.romaji: Tensei Shite mo Jikka wo Oida Sareta no de, Kondo wa Jibun no Ishi de Ikiteikimasu

title.native: ゆるふわママに甘えたい

208845.description:
Almonica, who possesses the "Menu Screen" skill, was kicked out of her childhood friends' party for being an incompetent pack mule capable of nothing more than storing items. However, the "Menu Screen" actually harbors numerous hidden functions she never revealed to the group... Now begins Almonica's journey to find companions she can truly trust!

(Source: Amazia)

title.english: From Zero to Hero with a Menu Screen! "I Can Pay-To-Win?!"
title.native: 役立たず冒険者【メニュー画面】で英雄に！　課金するほどチート機能が手に入るんですが!?
title.romaji: Yakutatazu Boukensha [Menu Gamen] de Eiyuu ni! Kakin suru Hodo Cheat Kinou ga Te ni Hairun desu ga!?

208846.description:
"Please, don't stay in my heart..." Ilya is a military prostitute known for not sleeping with customers, as she can calm her magical powers by singing. Though she grieves for the loss of her homeland, she is determined to remain cheerful and live a strong life. One day, she receives a secret request from Cian Asberg, a ruthless magician known as the "Silver Ice Knight." The higher the attack power, the more likely the magical power will go out of control. While soldiers usually sleep with prostitutes to calm it, Cian is famous for not sleeping with prostitutes. Wondering why she, a prostitute, would be there, she visits Cian, only to find him breathing in pain. This is a pure and heartbreaking love story of two sides: a lonely prostitute who cannot be honest with herself, and a knight who hides his purity behind a cold mask.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: とりあえず、ヤりましょう

208847.description:
I Love You So Why Can't We Have Sex!?

They might be a loving couple, but because of his boyfriend's overly serious nature, they still haven't had sex! A continuation. An overly serious baseball player and a guy who loves cooking and can't get his mind off sex! A couple with majorly differing statures.

title.native: のんたんは我慢できない
テレパス少女を黙らせたい

208851.description:
We were just childhood friends… until now. Once you start having feelings for them, there's no going back!

(Source: Ganma!, translated)
synonyms: The Way I Look at My Childhood Friend Has Changed
幼馴染を見る目が変わってしまった

title.native: 幼なじみを見る目が変わってしまった
title.romaji: Osananajimi wo Miru Me ga Kawatte Shimatta

208852.description: "Ecole de Eden" is a boarding school for girls located deep in the forest, completely isolated from the outside world. The students there are selected beautiful girls, and they are orphans. It is a dream place for the girls, where they can receive the same education as the daughters of the upper class, including etiquette and dance. But in this paradise there is a rule that must not be broken! That rule is that you must not go out into the outside world, and breaking the rule means death. The only way to go out is the graduation exam, which is held at the "Palace" at night. What is the graduation exam that awaits them?

title.native: エコール・ド・エデン

208853.description:
Senno Knife presents a book depicting an alley filled with the soul of the Showa era!! You'll be intrigued by the mysterious candy store granny who calls in customers by popping crackers, and the quirky friends who are waiting for you at the public bath! A roller game showdown is about to begin at the bathhouse, and it will be interesting to see how it turns out.

Contents:
"Battle at Tamakichi Yokocho"
"Tamakichi Yokocho: Weird Cat"
Includes explanations of Showa era items

208854.description:
A single book that Rachel wrote at the cost of her own life sparked a major controversy and even moved the world. How was Silent Spring, the work that became the catalyst for environmental protection, created?

Rachel loved observing nature and was skilled at writing. She entered university aspiring to become a writer, but in her second year, she was drawn to the appeal of biology and chose the path of science despite opposition from those around her. Though she struggled and stumbled along the way, she continued to follow the path she believed in, and through perseverance, eventually achieved success both as a biologist and as a bestselling author.

However, at the height of her life, a single letter arrived. It described the damage caused by synthetic chemical substances that were commonly used at the time. Fully prepared to face severe criticism, Rachel set out to write Silent Spring, exposing environmental destruction.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Note: Volume 24 in the series.

title.native: 角川まんが学習シリーズ まんが人物伝 レイチェル・カーソン 環境問題を訴えた生物学者
title.romaji: Kadokawa Manga Gakushuu Series: Manga Jinbutsu-den - Rachel Carson: Kankyou Mondai wo Uttaeta Seibutsugakusha

208855.description:
The story begins with a Japanese boy visiting the Van Gogh Museum in the present day, who then travels across time to experience Van Gogh's life firsthand. From his artistic awakening in Paris to the infamous ear-cutting incident, the manga traces a dramatic life filled with struggle and passion, while presenting many of his masterpieces along the way.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Note: Volume 28 in the series.

title.native: 角川まんが学習シリーズ　まんが人物伝 ゴッホ 希望の種をまいた不屈の画家
title.romaji: Kadokawa Manga Gakushuu Series: Manga Jinbutsu-den - Gogh: Kibou no Tane wo Maita Fukutsu no Gaka

208856.description:
Murasaki Shikibu was born into the family of a skilled scholar of Chinese studies, though her social status was not high.

In an era when women were expected to limit their learning to composing waka poetry, Shikibu devoted herself to Chinese studies and immersed herself in reading stories and diaries one after another. As she grew into an intelligent woman, she experienced marriage and separation, and eventually entered court life to serve Empress Akiko.

How was The Tale of Genji, a work that has been read and passed down around the world for over a thousand years, written and brought into being?

The Manga Jinbutsu-den series is a definitive biography manga that depicts how great figures spent their childhoods and went on to achieve remarkable accomplishments.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 角川まんが学習シリーズ まんが人物伝 紫式部
title.romaji: Kadokawa Manga Gakushuu Series: Manga Jinbutsu-den - Murasaki Shikibu

208858.description:
The late Anastasia Romanski was a female spy. When the media drops that bombshell, Stazy becomes a wanted woman by the press. Holed up in her grandfather's estate, she's visited by a young movie director, Jaxon, with a proposal to make a movie about her grandmother's life. Unfazed by a glass of water to the face for an answer, Jaxon stands firm in stating he merely wants to preserve the truth. Stazy accepts his offer, hoping to take the opportunity to disperse the horrid gossip haunting her family's history. However, while the two spend time investigating Anastasia's mysterious past, Stazy finds herself falling captive to Jaxon's charms. But is the gifted actor just wearing a mask with her, as well?

(Source: Renta!)

208859.description:
Anna has a secret. Behind the media's portrayal of her glamorous sex life of one-night stands with Hollywood hotties, she's just a popular model with a normal, plain life. However, her reputation perpetuates the myth, and there seems to be no end to men craving for one night with the supermodel. Greek business tycoon Damon Kouvaris is one such man. Anna curtly shoots him down, but a few days later she learns what happens when you make light of a Greek man's pride. Unless she agrees to go to dinner with him, it could mean trouble for the charity funds she's working hard to build.

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 恋こじらせて愛になる

synonyms: The second time around, you're staying with me.

title.native: 二度目の君は離れない
THE JINGAI―異種間BLアンソロジー―
みだらな猫は唇に誓う

title.native: タメにならない恋愛説法
きっと神様も知らない

208869.description:
He's the sun god Helios... Jessica can barely look at Alec, he burns so bright. The genius photographer asked Jessica to dinner, but she turned him down. The young actress takes some time away from filming, but she just can't get her mind off of him her sun god. She's falling for Alec and powerless before his charms.When their romance sparks, they're sure they were meant for each other from birth. Never in their wildest dreams did they imagine the day would come when they'd be torn apart...

(Source: Renta!)

208870.description:
Caitlyn is faced with the critical decision to sell her land-her home-to pay off her debts. Her only hope is financial support from a millionaire-the honorary son of an old sheik acquaintance of hers. But the man that comes to see her is her old boyfriend Luke! He was the traitor who worked for her father six years ago, but stole some money and ran away. And now he's fraternizing with the rich and famous? As she works to overcome the shock, Luke gazes coolly at her. He was the one who left Caitlyn, so why is he looking at her with such undisguised hatred in his eyes?

(Source: Renta!)

208871.description: Note: Originally published in Comic Yuri-Hime 2011 January issue.

208872.description:
Briony just became a secretary for company president Carlyle, famous as a workaholic. Just as she finishes an urgent job, a little girl bursts into the office: Carlyle's daughter, Emma. Briony is shocked by the instant change in her boss. The normally haughty man boasts a transformative smile as a proud single father. Briony ends up joining the pair on a trip to the amusement park, when Emma suddenly collapses in pain! Carlyle confesses that Emma has a heart condition, and has only a few months left to live. Not only that, but he begs Briony to fulfill his daughter's final wish-he wants Briony to marry him, and become Emma's mother!

(Source: Renta!)

title.romaji: Kekkon no na no Moto ni

208873.description:
Amelia is an unfortunate girl who lives off garden weeds instead of food. Born into an illegitimate family, she was abused by her family from an early age, and because of her shabby appearance, she was scorned in high society and called an "ugly young lady." One day, Amelia receives an offer of marriage. The suitor is the notorious "tyrannical duke," Duke Logan...!?

(Source: Overlap, translated)

title.native: 誰にも愛されなかった醜穢令嬢が幸せになるまで
title.romaji: Dare ni mo Aisare na katta Shuu e Reijou ga Shiawase ni naru made

208874.description:
Cecilia, a count's daughter, achieves her dream of marrying her beloved Ralph and joining the marquis' household. But on her wedding day, Ralph announces that his childhood friend Angela will be living with them. Though Cecilia initially accepts this arrangement, she begins to distrust the selfish Angela, Ralph, and her servants who prioritize her... Her newlywed life becomes difficult, and Cecilia finally decides to escape from Ralph's house, but... !?

(Source: AlphaPolis, translated)

title.native: 旦那様は妻の私より幼馴染の方が大切なようです

208875.description: Note: Originally published in Comic Yuri-Hime 2008 Summer issue.

208876.description:
Learn the full back story behind the world's greatest book on military strategy! The Art of War is one of the world's great masterpieces—presenting timeless strategies that are as important in the boardroom as on the battlefield. Now, experience Sun Tzu's classic as never before in this riveting graphic novel brimming with battles, betrayals and political intrigues.

The book recounts the conflict between the kingdom of Wu as they plot to attack the far more powerful state of Chu, with both leaders navigating internal plots and power struggles that will forever alter the fate of China.

The fascinating accounts in this book include:

The story of Sun Tzu, who became a trusted advisor to the powerful Wu clan and then a master military strategist, capturing the attention of Wu Zixu, the clan's most formidable general The creation of the military strategies in The Art of War, as Sun Tzu develops his revolutionary philosophy of asymmetrical warfare The high-stakes Battle of Boju where Sun Tzu's teachings take center stage, shaping a battle that will become legendary in the chronicles of military history And many other fascinating stories!

Sun Tzu's Art of War brings to life not only the tactical brilliance of Sun Tzu's teachings but also the human drama behind them—the ambition, sacrifice and the relentless pursuit of victory!

(Source: Tuttle Publishing)
synonyms: Sun Tzu's Art of War: The Manga Edition: The Full Story Behind Sun Tzu's Masterpiece!

title.english: Sun Tzu's Art of War: The Manga Edition

208878.description:
Five years apart, and he's nothing like the "brother" she remembers. Joanne is still innocent and untouched by the world, but Reid has been spinning a web of sweet deception in the shadows. Playing the role of protective older brother, he moves closer with calculated precision—all to stir the feelings she's kept buried deep inside. When forbidden memories resurface, logic battles desire—"Forget the past if you want," he murmurs, his smile dangerously inviting, "but come any closer, and I'm never letting you go."

(Source: WebComics)

208882.description:
In her past life, she was betrayed by her scumbag husband and her sister, thrown into a mental institution, and tormented to death. But when she opened her eyes once more, she had been reborn… right before she had gotten married to her backstabbing husband. This time, she's not letting them off easily. Didn’t they call her crazy? Very well then. She would show them just how crazy she can be and make them regret ever crossing her!

(Source: WebComics)

208884.description:
Livia, a noble lady, has been having strange dreams lately.

— Dreams of being defeated on a battlefield, exchanging marriage vows with her aide's final breath, as he died shielding her — even though she never remembers the details upon waking.

Then one day, at a party in the royal palace, Livia meets Claudio, the knight-commander and heir of the grand duke. In that instant, the past became clear, and Livia recalls… that Claudio before her was none other than Louis, the aide she had pledged marriage in her previous life, when she was known as Beatrice!

Claudio, who shares her memories of their past lives, immediately proposes to Livia, leaving her flustered and bewildered.

It soon becomes clear that many souls from her past life have reincarnated around Livia. To make matters worse, another “fiancé” from her previous life appears, which will draw her into a major conflict that will shake the kingdom, all stemming from their past lives…!?

An ultimate reincarnation love story unfolds, where love and fate intertwine, untouched by the passage of time!

(Source: Lanove Bunko, translated)

title.native: 「来世で結婚してくれますか」と誓った部下が、現世では年上の騎士団長様になっていて、本当に結婚を迫られている件

208885.description:
Through an introduction from a college senior, rookie lyricist Baek Ji-Seok lands a job at an A&R company and is tasked with writing lyrics for famous singer Cha Do-Yun's new song. But in the process, he gets his lyrics stolen and finds himself facing the threat of being sued instead...

When Ji-Seok is pushed to the edge of a cliff, the one extending a hand of salvation is none other than Cha Do-Yun?!

“Why are you helping me?”

A cohabitation begins with the inscrutable Do-Yun. Will Ji-Seok manage to write the lyrics safely?

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: [BL 특별편] Be My Valentine(비 마이 발렌타인)

208887.description:
Drunk, Eun-Seong nearly had sex with his long-time crush, Jeong-Hyeop, but mistakenly believed the person was Jeong-Hyeop's older brother, Jeong-Woo. Jeong-Hyeop, seeing Eun-Seong acting as if nothing happened, falls into another misunderstanding, thinking she likes Jeong-Woo instead...

Childhood friends' mutual crushes making a complete mess of things.

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapters.

208888.description:
During high school, Yu Kyung-Ho unexpectedly reunites with Lim Jae-Ha, who was once a complete jerk. Kyung-Ho finds this reunion after eight years nothing but uncomfortable, and to make matters worse, he gets caught by his ex-boyfriend! No matter how much Kyung-Ho tries to avoid Jae-Ha, he keeps hovering around, tormenting him...

“What else could it be? I came to help you out of pity.”

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

208889.description:
"You only have me, don't you?"

Jung-Woo, who had maintained a steady sexual relationship with ‘Seung-Hyuk’ for ten years despite being hated by him, the object of his unrequited love. Just as he was about to make an extreme choice due to the stagnant relationship, he accidentally meets ‘Kang-Chan’ and has his life saved. As Kang-Chan offers genuine kindness, promising to help advance his relationship with Seung-Hyuk, Jung-Woo gradually opens his heart to him...

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

Note: Include one extra chapter.

Pedro the Wolf, a fugitive with a 200 million won bounty, discovers an abandoned factory while weary from his long life on the run. Inside the factory lies the first boar, reduced to a wreck after everything he owned was burned in an arson incident Pedro had committed. Pedro sees meeting him during his rut as a chance...

208919.description:
Her first love met its end—

“I believed this would be the only love of my life…”

Rachelia, the marquis’s daughter of the Kingdom of Gasel, is the childhood friend of Crown Prince Bradford and his most likely future bride. But everything changes when Bradford falls in love with another noblewoman, Alamoana, whom he meets by chance.

Forgetting both his duties and his station, the prince becomes wholly consumed by this new love, never once noticing the quiet, heartbreaking devotion Rachelia has carried for him since childhood.

As she continues to give and give, sacrificing herself for a love that may never be returned, how much longer can her heart endure?

This is the story of a gentle, unwavering love pushed to its very limits.

208924.description:
One day, after losing his life in an unexpected accident, he is reincarnated into another world as Rain, the eldest son of the Proud Lord family, a local noble family. Having received a natural talent for magic from God when he was reincarnated, Rain, who can now use "synthetic magic" that combines attributes, tries to use this talent to live a comfortable life in his territory, but...!? Aim for a comfortable slow life with Fenrir's young Shiro, whom I picked up in the forest during my magical training!!

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

208925.description:
His "imaginary girlfriend" doesn't have anything down there...!?

Kuuta, a boy who grew up in the countryside with a communication disorder, has an imaginary girlfriend. Though a delusion, Nari seems entirely real: a bit jealous, but beautiful, erotic, family-oriented... truly the best. In order to have sex with her, he needs to get to know real women and increase the image resolution of his imaginary girlfriend... She's devoted, but forming a harem...!? An exciting new youth love comedy!

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)
